plot: 贝蒂来到好莱坞想当演员，在住处发现一个因车祸失忆的女人。两个人给她取名丽塔，一起追查她是谁。
plot_en: Betty comes to Hollywood to be an actress and finds, in the place where she is staying, a woman who has lost her memory in a car crash. The two of them name her Rita and try to find out who she is.

plot: 股票经纪人乔丹·贝尔福特开了自己的公司，靠劝客户买垃圾股赚钱。钱和药把整个办公室拖着往上走，联邦调查也跟着来了。
plot_en: The stockbroker Jordan Belfort opens his own firm and makes money by talking clients into buying junk stocks. Money and drugs pull the whole office upward, and a federal investigation follows.

plot: 垃圾清理机器人瓦力在废弃的地球上日复一日打包垃圾。探测机器人伊娃落地取样，他跟着她离开地球，上了一艘载着全部人类的飞船。
plot_en: The trash robot WALL-E packs garbage day after day on an abandoned Earth. The probe EVE lands to take a sample. He follows her off the planet, onto a ship carrying what is left of humanity.

plot: 1986 年，韩国一座小城里连续发生强奸杀人案。本地警察朴斗万靠拳头和直觉办案，从首尔调来的徐泰允坚持要证据。嫌疑人被一个个抓来，又一个个对不上。
plot_en: In 1986 a series of rape-murders hits a small city in Korea. The local detective Park Doo-man works by instinct and his fists. Seo Tae-yoon, sent from Seoul, insists on evidence. Suspects are brought in one after another, and none of them fit.

plot: 弗罗多从比尔博手里接过一枚戒指，甘道夫告诉他这枚戒指必须毁掉。他和同伴离开夏尔，在幽谷和其他几路人会合成护戒队，往摩多进发。
plot_en: Frodo receives a ring from Bilbo, and Gandalf tells him the ring has to be destroyed. He and his companions leave the Shire, meet the others at Rivendell, and the Fellowship sets out for Mordor.

plot: 高山旅馆的礼宾员古斯塔夫被一位老客人写进遗嘱，随即被栽成凶手。门童零跟着他逃，也听他讲这家旅馆以前的样子。
plot_en: Gustave, the concierge of a mountain hotel, is written into an old guest’s will and is promptly framed for murder. The lobby boy Zero flees with him, and listens to him describe what the hotel used to be.

plot: 伊拉克战场上，詹姆斯中士接替阵亡的前任，领导一支拆弹小组。他对危险的判断和另外两名组员不一样。轮休回到家里之后，他也不知道自己还能做什么。
plot_en: On the Iraq war’s bomb squads, Sergeant James replaces a predecessor who was killed and leads a three-man team. His sense of the danger is not the same as the other two men’s. When he rotates home, he does not know what else he can do.

plot: 弗兰西丝在纽约学舞蹈，和最好的朋友索菲合租。索菲决定搬走之后，她开始在别人家里短住，工作也没有着落。
plot_en: Frances is studying dance in New York and shares an apartment with her best friend Sophie. After Sophie decides to move out, Frances starts staying short stretches in other people’s homes, and the work dries up.

plot: 1965 年印尼屠杀中动过手的人，如今是地方上的头面人物。摄制组请他们挑选一种电影类型，把当年怎么杀人重演出来。
plot_en: Men who took part in the 1965 killings in Indonesia are now local figures of standing. The filmmakers ask them to choose a movie genre and reenact how they killed.

plot: 大学物理教师拉里觉得每件事都在松：妻子要跟别人走，学生拿钱来换及格，一封匿名信正在毁掉他的终身教职。他去找拉比，想知道自己做错了什么。
plot_en: Larry, a university physics teacher, feels everything coming loose: his wife is leaving him for someone else, a student offers money for a passing grade, and an anonymous letter is ruining his tenure. He goes to the rabbis to find out what he did wrong.

plot: 千寻和父母误入神灵的城镇，父母因为贪吃变成了猪。她在汤屋老板娘那里干活，想把父母变回来，也想帮白龙记起自己是谁。
plot_en: Chihiro and her parents wander into a town of spirits, and her parents are turned into pigs for eating too much. She goes to work for the woman who runs the bathhouse, trying to turn her parents back, and to help Haku remember who he is.

plot: 十二岁的奥斯卡住在斯德哥尔摩的公寓楼里，在学校被人欺负。新搬来的伊莱只在夜里出现，不觉得冷，向他提议做朋友。同一片社区开始有人失踪。
plot_en: Twelve-year-old Oskar lives in an apartment block in Stockholm and is bullied at school. The new neighbor, Eli, appears only at night, does not feel the cold, and offers to be his friend. People in the same neighborhood start to disappear.

plot: 1930 年代的密西西比，埃弗雷特带着两个同伴逃出苦役营，去找他声称埋下的宝藏。路上他们灌了唱片、卷进州长竞选，警察也一直跟在后面。
plot_en: In Mississippi in the 1930s, Everett escapes a prison farm with two companions to find a treasure he says he buried. Along the way they cut a record and get pulled into a governor’s race, and the police stay behind them.

plot: 几组差别很大的人带着自己的狗，从各地赶到费城参加全国犬展。镜头轮流跟着他们上路、入住，直到比赛当天牵狗入场。
plot_en: Several very different people bring their dogs from around the country to Philadelphia for a national dog show. The camera follows them on the road and into their hotels, up to the moment they walk the dogs into the ring.

plot: 特诺奇和胡利奥自称知道一处秘密海滩，说服已婚的路易莎跟他们上路。三个人往海边开，车上的话一次比一次越界。
plot_en: Tenoch and Julio claim to know a secret beach and talk the married Luisa into coming with them. The three of them drive toward the sea, and the talk in the car crosses a line a little further each time.

plot: 气球推销员卡尔在妻子艾莉去世后，用成千上万只气球把房子拔起来，按两人年轻时的约定飞往南美。童子军小罗意外留在了门廊上。
plot_en: After his wife Ellie dies, the balloon salesman Carl lifts the house with thousands of balloons and flies toward South America, as the two of them agreed when they were young. The scout Russell is left on the porch by accident.

plot: 1944 年西班牙，奥菲莉亚跟着母亲嫁给一个残暴的军官。她在迷宫里遇到羊首神，对方交给她三件事，说她本是地下王国的公主。
plot_en: In Spain in 1944, Ofelia follows her mother into a marriage with a brutal officer. In a labyrinth she meets a faun, who gives her three tasks and tells her she is the princess of an underground kingdom.

plot: 1963 年，恩尼斯和杰克被雇去山上放羊，夏天结束之后各回各家。后来很多年，他们以钓鱼为名见面，两边都有了妻子和孩子。
plot_en: In 1963 Ennis and Jack are hired to herd sheep in the mountains. When the summer ends they go back to their own lives. For years afterward they meet on the excuse of fishing. Both have wives and children.

plot: 黑帮头目科斯特洛在警队里安了眼线，州警也把新人送进他的团伙。两个卧底都在找对方是谁，也都得先保住自己。
plot_en: The gang boss Costello has an informer inside the police, and the state police send a new man into his crew. The two moles are each looking for the other, and each has to keep himself alive first.

plot: 李慕白托俞秀莲把青冥剑送给贝勒爷，剑在路上被玉娇龙抢走。秀莲追剑，罗小虎在沙漠里等娇龙做选择，李慕白把很多话留在嘴里。
plot_en: Li Mu Bai asks Yu Shu Lien to take the Green Destiny sword to Sir Te. Jade Fox’s pupil Jen steals it on the way. Shu Lien goes after the sword, Lo waits in the desert for Jen to choose, and Li Mu Bai leaves a great deal unsaid.

plot: 靠代人写信为生的西奥多刚结束一段婚姻，买回家一个会说话的操作系统。系统给自己取名萨曼莎，两个人越聊越近。
plot_en: Theodore writes letters for other people for a living and has just ended a marriage. He brings home an operating system that can talk. The system names itself Samantha, and the two of them grow closer the more they talk.

plot: 过气影星鲍勃到东京拍威士忌广告，整夜睡不着。同住一家酒店的夏洛特随丈夫出差，丈夫却忙着别的事。两个人开始一起在城里耗时间。
plot_en: Bob, a movie star past his peak, is in Tokyo to shoot a whiskey commercial and cannot sleep. Charlotte is staying in the same hotel with her husband, who is busy with other things. The two of them start spending time in the city together.

plot: 小丑把高谭的黑帮和市民一起拖进他的规矩里，逼蝙蝠侠在公开身份和继续戴面具之间选。检察官哈维·丹特本来是这座城市的另一个希望。
plot_en: The Joker drags Gotham’s gangs and its citizens into his rules, and forces Batman to choose between revealing who he is and keeping the mask. The prosecutor Harvey Dent was the city’s other hope.

plot: 地球上的粮食正在枯萎。前工程师库珀被招募去飞离太阳系，为人类找下一处能落脚的地方。他出发的时候，女儿墨菲还是个孩子。
plot_en: The crops on Earth are dying. Cooper, a former engineer, is recruited to leave the solar system and find the next place humanity can land. When he sets out, his daughter Murph is still a child.

plot: 丹尼·奥申刑满出狱，目标是三家赌场共用的一个金库。他找来老搭档鲁斯蒂，再凑齐另外九个人，每人负责一道他自己过不去的关。
plot_en: Danny Ocean gets out of prison and sets his sights on a vault shared by three casinos. He finds his old partner Rusty and makes up the other nine, each of them responsible for a step Danny cannot get past himself.

plot: 1944 年，阿尔多中尉带着一队犹太美军在被占领的法国猎杀纳粹。同一时间，犹太女子肖莎娜经营着一家即将为纳粹高层放映电影的电影院。
plot_en: In 1944 Lieutenant Aldo leads a unit of Jewish American soldiers hunting Nazis in occupied France. At the same time, the Jewish woman Shosanna is running a cinema that is about to screen a film for the Nazi high command.

plot: 华盛顿用三个能预见谋杀的人，在罪行发生之前把凶手抓走。预犯罪组的队长约翰有一天在系统里看见了自己的名字。
plot_en: Washington uses three people who can see murders before they happen, and arrests the killers before the crime. One day John, the chief of Precrime, sees his own name in the system.

plot: 艾米莉在蒙马特一家咖啡馆当服务员，喜欢替陌生人安排小小的好事，自己的感情却不敢说。她把一只童年的铁盒还回去，也开始注意一个常来店里的男人。
plot_en: Amélie waits tables at a café in Montmartre. She likes arranging small good turns for strangers and cannot say what she feels. She returns a tin box from someone’s childhood, and starts to notice a man who keeps coming into the café.

plot: 1960 年代末，一个自称十二宫的人向旧金山的报纸寄密码和行凶声明。漫画家罗伯特放下画漫画的工作，用很多年去核对嫌疑人。
plot_en: In the late 1960s a man calling himself the Zodiac sends ciphers and claims of murder to the San Francisco papers. The cartoonist Robert puts the cartoons aside and spends years checking suspects.

plot: 味觉敏锐的老鼠雷米不愿意再吃垃圾。他跑到巴黎一家曾经辉煌的餐厅，钻进学徒林贵尼的帽子，靠拉头发指挥这个不会做菜的人。
plot_en: Remy, a rat with a sharp palate, will not eat garbage anymore. He runs to a once-great restaurant in Paris, climbs into the toque of the apprentice Linguini, and directs this person who cannot cook by pulling his hair.

plot: 结婚五周年这天，艾米在家里失踪，现场留下挣扎的痕迹。警方和媒体很快把怀疑转向她的丈夫尼克，尼克自己的说法也越来越站不住。
plot_en: On their fifth anniversary Amy disappears from the house, and the scene shows signs of a struggle. The police and the press quickly turn their suspicion on her husband Nick, and Nick’s own account becomes harder and harder to stand on.

plot: 十九岁的马利克进了法国监狱，哪一伙都不算。科西嘉黑帮让他去杀人，他照做，同时把监狱内外的关系一点点攒到自己手上。
plot_en: Malik enters a French prison at nineteen, belonging to no crew. The Corsican gang tells him to kill someone. He does it, and at the same time gathers the relationships inside and outside the prison into his own hands.

plot: 蕾蒙达回老家探望姑姑，却发现母亲的鬼魂出现在镇上。她带回马德里的不只是这件事，还有妹妹家里一具必须处理掉的尸体。
plot_en: Raimunda goes back to her hometown to see her aunt and finds her mother’s ghost in the town. What she brings back to Madrid is not only that, but a body in her sister’s house that has to be dealt with.

plot: 新娘在婚礼彩排上被前任比尔带领的刺杀小队枪击，昏迷了四年。醒来之后她写下名单，从冲绳的制刀师傅和东京的一栋豪宅开始，一个一个找回去。
plot_en: The Bride is shot at her wedding rehearsal by her former lover Bill and his assassination squad, and spends four years in a coma. When she wakes she writes a list and starts working back through it, beginning with a sword maker in Okinawa and a house in Tokyo.

plot: 十五岁的米娅住在埃塞克斯的公屋里，和母亲、妹妹互相看不顺眼，自己关起门来跳舞。母亲的新男友康纳搬进来，对她跳舞的事表现出兴趣。
plot_en: Fifteen-year-old Mia lives on an Essex estate, cannot stand her mother or her sister, and dances behind a closed door. Her mother’s new boyfriend, Connor, moves in and takes an interest in the dancing.

plot: 鼓手安德鲁进了音乐学院，被教师弗莱彻选进核心乐队。弗莱彻用辱骂和淘汰逼他打得更快，安德鲁也开始把别的事情都让开。
plot_en: The drummer Andrew gets into a conservatory and is picked by the teacher Fletcher for the core band. Fletcher uses insults and cuts to make him play faster, and Andrew starts moving everything else out of the way.

plot: 简南俊的母亲昏迷不醒，公司正谈着一桩他没有把握的生意，初恋从日本出现。儿子杨杨拿相机拍人的背面，女儿正在谈一场不让家里知道的恋情。
plot_en: Jian’s mother is in a coma. His company is in the middle of a deal he is not sure of, and a first love appears from Japan. His son Yang-Yang photographs the backs of people’s heads. His daughter is in a romance she is keeping from the family.

plot: 1950 年代，百货公司店员特芮丝在柜台边遇见来给女儿买礼物的卡罗尔。卡罗尔正在打一场对她不利的离婚官司，两个人还是一起出了门。
plot_en: In the 1950s the department-store clerk Therese meets Carol at the counter, where Carol has come to buy a gift for her daughter. Carol is in the middle of a divorce that is going against her. The two of them leave together anyway.

plot: 柯布靠进入别人的梦境盗取秘密为生。这一次的任务反过来，是要把一个想法种进一位继承人的脑子。他带着一支队伍往更深层的梦里走。
plot_en: Cobb makes his living by entering other people’s dreams and stealing secrets. This time the job is the reverse: to plant an idea in an heir’s mind. He takes a team down into deeper layers of the dream.

plot: 编剧查理接下一本关于兰花窃贼的书，却怎么也改编不出来。他写着写着，把自己和双胞胎弟弟唐纳德都写进了剧本。
plot_en: The screenwriter Charlie takes on a book about an orchid thief and cannot adapt it. As he writes, he writes himself, and his twin brother Donald, into the script.

plot: 特查拉回到瓦坎达即位。流亡在外的埃里克带着父亲留下的委屈回来争夺王位，也要把这个国家藏起来的技术交到外面的人手里。
plot_en: T’Challa returns to Wakanda to take the throne. Erik, in exile, comes back with his father’s grievance to contest the crown, and to put the technology the country has been hiding into other people’s hands.

plot: 《波士顿环球报》的新主编让调查组看看一条旧线索：天主教神父性侵儿童，教会用调职把事情压下去。小组从一份名单开始，去敲受害人的门。
plot_en: The new editor of The Boston Globe tells the investigations team to look at an old lead: Catholic priests abused children, and the church buried it by transferring them. The team starts from a list and knocks on the victims’ doors.

plot: 十二艘外星飞船停在地球各处，舱里的生物用一圈圈墨水一样的符号交流。语言学家路易斯被军方找去，负责弄懂这些符号。
plot_en: Twelve alien ships stop over different places on Earth. The beings inside communicate with ink-like rings of symbols. The linguist Louise is brought in by the military to work out what the symbols mean.

plot: 企业顾问伊内丝在罗马尼亚帮客户裁员。父亲觉得她已经不认识自己了，于是戴上假牙，以生活教练的身份出现在她的客户中间。
plot_en: Ines, a corporate consultant, is in Romania helping a client cut staff. Her father decides she no longer knows him, puts in false teeth, and turns up among her clients as a life coach.

plot: 体弱的安妮女王少问政事，女伴萨拉长期替她拿主意。萨拉的穷亲戚阿比盖尔进宫当了女仆，很快成为另一个能靠近女王的人。
plot_en: Queen Anne is frail and asks little about affairs of state. Her companion Sarah has long made the decisions for her. Sarah’s poor cousin Abigail enters the palace as a maid and soon becomes another person who can get close to the queen.

plot: 迈阿密一个瘦小的男孩跟着毒贩长大，少年时爱上来往的同学。成年后他换了名字和身材，在餐厅里等这个人出现。
plot_en: A thin boy in Miami grows up around a drug dealer, and as a teenager falls in love with a classmate. As an adult he has a different name and a different body, and waits in a restaurant for that person to appear.

plot: 哈佛学生扎克伯格一夜写出给同学打分的网站，随后和室友一起做了后来的 Facebook。公司做大之后，他和联合创始人、早期投资人相继对簿公堂。
plot_en: The Harvard student Zuckerberg writes, in one night, a site that rates his classmates, and then builds what becomes Facebook with his roommates. After the company grows, he ends up in court against a co-founder and against an early investor.

plot: 乔尔发现前女友克莱门汀已经把自己从记忆里删掉，于是也去做同样的手术。删除进行的时候，他在脑子里拼命想把她留下来。
plot_en: Joel discovers that his ex-girlfriend Clementine has had him erased from her memory, and goes to have the same procedure. While the deletion is underway, he tries, inside his own mind, to keep her.

plot: 克里斯汀给自己改名伯德小姐，一心要离开萨克拉门托去东海岸上大学。母亲认为家里没有这笔钱，两个人把申请、打工和一场舞会都吵成了架。
plot_en: Christine renames herself Lady Bird and is determined to leave Sacramento for college on the East Coast. Her mother says the family does not have the money. Applications, a job, and a dance all turn into fights.

plot: 六岁的莫妮和朋友们住在奥兰多迪士尼旁边的廉价汽车旅馆里，整个夏天在楼道和快餐店之间玩。母亲海莉靠着出租房间和别的办法挣房租。
plot_en: Six-year-old Moonee and her friends live in a cheap motel next to Disney World in Orlando, and spend the summer playing between the corridors and the fast-food shops. Her mother Halley makes the rent by letting rooms and by other means.

plot: 1983 年夏天，埃利奥在意大利的家里认识了来协助父亲做研究的美国研究生奥利弗。几周里两个人从试探走到一起。夏天结束，奥利弗要回美国。
plot_en: In the summer of 1983, at his family’s house in Italy, Elio meets Oliver, an American graduate student who has come to help Elio’s father with his research. Over a few weeks the two of them move from testing each other to being together. When the summer ends, Oliver goes back to the United States.

plot: 裁缝雷诺兹·伍德科克在伦敦给名流做裙子，生活由姐姐和固定的作息管着。女服务员阿尔玛进了工作室，当他的模特，也要在这栋房子里有自己的位置。
plot_en: The dressmaker Reynolds Woodcock makes gowns for the famous in London. His sister and a fixed routine run the house. The waitress Alma comes into the workroom as his model, and wants a place of her own in that house.

plot: 克里斯跟着白人女友回她家的乡下过周末。父母热情得过分，园丁和女佣的反应却很怪，夜里他还被拉进一场听不懂的聚会。
plot_en: Chris goes with his white girlfriend to her family’s place in the country for the weekend. The parents are excessively warm. The gardener and the housekeeper react strangely. At night he is pulled into a gathering he cannot follow.

plot: 女佣克利奥在墨西哥城一户中产人家里干活，女主人的丈夫长期不回家。克利奥自己有了身孕，孩子的父亲却不见了。
plot_en: The maid Cleo works for a middle-class family in Mexico City. The lady of the house has a husband who stays away. Cleo herself becomes pregnant, and the father of the child disappears.

plot: 芭蕾舞者妮娜争取《天鹅湖》里白天鹅和黑天鹅两个角色。导演逼她放出自己控制不住的那一面，她开始在排练厅和家里看见另一个自己。
plot_en: The ballet dancer Nina is competing for both the White Swan and the Black Swan in Swan Lake. The director pushes her to let out the side of herself she cannot control, and she starts seeing another self in the rehearsal room and at home.

plot: 导演开着车在法国的乡下和城市里找那些捡剩东西的人。有人捡收割机留下的土豆，有人在菜市场打烊后捡菜，也有人把捡来的东西做成作品。
plot_en: The director drives through the countryside and the cities of France looking for people who pick up what is left. Some take the potatoes a harvester missed, some take vegetables after a market closes, and some turn what they find into work of their own.

plot: 律师迈克尔专门替事务所收拾麻烦。同事阿瑟在经手一家大公司的集体诉讼时精神崩溃，当众指责客户，迈克尔被派去让他停下来。
plot_en: The lawyer Michael is the person his firm sends to clean up trouble. His colleague Arthur, handling a class action against a large company, has a breakdown and denounces the client in public. Michael is sent to make him stop.

plot: 1969 年，过气演员里克·道尔顿和替身演员克利夫在好莱坞找下一份工作。他们的邻居是罗曼·波兰斯基，同一条街上有一群年轻人正打那栋房子的主意。
plot_en: In 1969 the fading actor Rick Dalton and his stunt double Cliff are looking for the next job in Hollywood. Their neighbor is Roman Polanski. On the same street, a group of young people is taking an interest in that house.

plot: 鲁道夫·霍斯是奥斯维辛集中营的指挥官。电影跟着他的妻子和孩子住在墙外的别墅里：种花、请客、挑选从营地送来的衣服。
plot_en: Rudolf Höss is the commandant of Auschwitz. The film stays with his wife and children in the villa outside the wall: planting flowers, having guests, choosing clothes sent over from the camp.

plot: 珠宝商霍华德把一颗黑蛋白石寄在店里，同时欠着高利贷，还把钱押在凯尔特人队的比赛上。每一笔新的都用来补上一笔的洞。
plot_en: The jeweler Howard keeps a black opal in the shop, owes a loan shark, and has his money on a Celtics game. Each new sum is used to plug the hole left by the last one.

plot: 医学工程师斯通在第一次太空行走时碰上卫星碎片的连锁碰撞，飞船毁了。她和资深宇航员马特被留在轨道上，得自己找到下一艘还能用的船。
plot_en: On her first spacewalk, the medical engineer Stone is caught in a chain collision of satellite debris, and the craft is destroyed. She and the veteran astronaut Matt are left in orbit and have to find the next ship that still works.

plot: 哈萨克记者博拉特奉命到美国拍一部了解当地文化的纪录片。他带着制片人走访各地，用采访把遇到的人推进他自己准备好的剧本。
plot_en: Borat, a Kazakh journalist, is sent to the United States to film a documentary about the local culture. He and his producer travel the country, using interviews to push the people they meet into the script he has already prepared.

plot: 金家四口住在半地下室，靠折叠披萨盒过活。儿子伪造学历，进了朴社长家当家教，父母和妹妹也跟着一个个混进去。
plot_en: The four Kims live in a semi-basement and get by folding pizza boxes. The son forges his credentials and enters the Park household as a tutor. His parents and his sister follow him in, one by one.

plot: 蒂莫西·崔德威尔每年夏天独自住到阿拉斯加的灰熊中间，用摄像机记下自己和熊。2003 年，他和女友死于熊的袭击。电影用他留下的素材回看这些夏天。
plot_en: Every summer Timothy Treadwell lived alone among the grizzlies in Alaska and filmed himself with the bears. In 2003 he and his girlfriend were killed in a bear attack. The film looks back at those summers through the footage he left.

plot: 画家玛丽安受雇给即将出嫁的小姐埃洛伊兹画一幅肖像，条件是不能让她知道自己在被画。每天陪她散步之后，这件差事保不住了。
plot_en: The painter Marianne is hired to paint a portrait of Héloïse, who is about to be married, on the condition that Héloïse not know she is being painted. After the daily walks, the arrangement cannot hold.

plot: 伊芙琳在洗衣店楼上准备接待税务员，父亲从中国来访，女儿也不肯好好说话。另一个宇宙里的丈夫告诉她，她是唯一能跳进自己所有人生的人。
plot_en: Evelyn is upstairs from the laundromat, preparing to meet a tax auditor. Her father is visiting from China, and her daughter will not talk to her properly. A husband from another universe tells her she is the only one who can jump into all of her lives.

plot: 安妮的蛋糕店倒了，手头的恋情也一塌糊涂。闺蜜莉莲要结婚，请她当伴娘，另一位有钱的伴娘处处跟她比。
plot_en: Annie’s cake shop has failed, and so has the relationship she is in. Her friend Lillian is getting married and asks her to be a bridesmaid. Another, wealthy bridesmaid competes with her at every turn.

plot: 1984 年东柏林，史塔西上尉维斯勒受命监听剧作家德雷曼和他的女友。监听持续了很久，他写进报告的内容开始和耳机里听到的不一样。
plot_en: In East Berlin in 1984, the Stasi captain Wiesler is ordered to listen in on the playwright Dreyman and his girlfriend. The surveillance goes on for a long time. What he writes in his reports starts to differ from what he hears in the headphones.

plot: 火箭想当摄影师，不想加入贩毒。和他一起长大的里欧则在里约的贫民窟里把地盘和枪都抓到自己手里。故事从几支枪的转手讲起。
plot_en: Rocket wants to be a photographer, not a drug dealer. Li’l Zé, who grew up with him, takes the territory and the guns in a Rio slum into his own hands. The story starts with a few guns changing owners.

plot: 纳德和西敏要离婚。西敏想带女儿出国，纳德放不下患有老年痴呆的父亲。一次护工的事故之后，两家人被卷进同一场官司。
plot_en: Nader and Simin are divorcing. Simin wants to take their daughter abroad; Nader will not leave his father, who has dementia. After an accident involving the carer, both families are pulled into the same court case.

plot: 奥克兰运动家队没有钱和豪门抢球星，还是得组出下一季的阵容。总经理比利·比恩不再按球探的眼缘买人，改看上垒率这些被市场看低的数字。
plot_en: The Oakland Athletics do not have the money to bid against rich clubs for stars, and still have to build next season’s roster. The general manager Billy Beane stops buying players on a scout’s hunch and starts looking at numbers the market undervalues, such as on-base percentage.

plot: 贾斯汀在自己的婚礼上崩溃，谁也拉不住她。婚后她搬去姐姐克莱尔家，天空里一颗叫「忧郁」的行星正在靠近，姐姐开始害怕，她反而不再怕。
plot_en: Justine falls apart at her own wedding, and no one can pull her back. Afterward she moves in with her sister Claire. A planet called Melancholia is approaching in the sky. Claire starts to be afraid. Justine stops being afraid.

plot: 朱莉三十岁，医学院读到一半转去学心理学，后来又想去拍照。她离开同居的男友，在酒吧认识了另一个人，然后发现自己还是定不下来。
plot_en: Julie is thirty. She leaves medical school halfway through for psychology, and later wants to take photographs. She leaves the boyfriend she lives with, meets someone else in a bar, and finds she still cannot settle.

plot: 娜英小时候随家人从首尔移民，和男同学海成断了联系。二十多年后她在纽约当编剧、已经结婚，海成飞来见她。
plot_en: Nora leaves Seoul with her family as a child and loses touch with her classmate Hae Sung. More than twenty years later she is a writer in New York and already married, and Hae Sung flies in to see her.

plot: 吴大修在一个看不出位置的房间里被关了十五年，电视是他唯一的窗口。放出来的那天，对方给他五天，去查出是谁关的他、为什么。
plot_en: Oh Dae-su is locked for fifteen years in a room whose location he cannot tell. Television is his only window. The day he is let out, the other side gives him five days to find out who locked him up, and why.

plot: 退伍兵弗雷迪靠私酿酒过日子，在船上被兰开斯特·多德看中。多德领导着一个叫「源」的组织，把弗雷迪留在身边，既当实验对象，也当跟班。
plot_en: The veteran Freddie gets by on liquor he brews himself, and is picked out on a boat by Lancaster Dodd. Dodd leads an organization called the Cause and keeps Freddie beside him, as a subject and as a follower.

plot: 退伍兵在沙漠里发现一笔毒贩没来得及带走的钱，决定带走。一个拿着汽枪的杀手沿途追上来，镇上的老警长看着这件事往下走。
plot_en: A veteran finds, in the desert, a sum of money that drug dealers did not have time to take, and decides to take it. A killer with a cattle gun follows the trail. The old sheriff in town watches it go on.

plot: 丹尼尔·普莱恩维尤从一口油井起家，把周围的地都买到自己名下。当地年轻牧师伊莱要分他的钱，也要他当众认罪。
plot_en: Daniel Plainview starts from a single oil well and buys up the land around it. Eli, a young local preacher, wants a share of the money, and wants Daniel to confess in public.

plot: 自由的黑人小提琴手所罗门·诺瑟普被两个男人诱到华盛顿，醒来时已经被卖掉。从这一天起，他以奴隶的身份在路易斯安那的种植园之间被转手。
plot_en: Solomon Northup, a free Black violinist, is lured to Washington by two men and wakes to find he has been sold. From that day he is passed from plantation to plantation in Louisiana as a slave.

plot: 不死老乔把荒漠里的水和油握在自己手里。弗瑞奥萨劫走他的妻妾，麦克斯被绑在车头上，一整队战车追着这辆油罐车跑。
plot_en: Immortan Joe holds the water and the gasoline in the wasteland. Furiosa steals his wives. Max is strapped to the front of a car, and a whole convoy of war machines chases the tanker.

plot: 莱尼的短时记忆只维持得了几分钟。妻子被害之后，他用拍立得、便签和纹在身上的字继续追查，因为他记不住上一刻发生了什么。
plot_en: Lenny’s short-term memory lasts only a few minutes. After his wife is murdered, he keeps investigating with Polaroids, notes, and words tattooed on his body, because he cannot remember what happened a moment ago.

plot: 胡佛家收到通知，小女儿奥利芙进了加州儿童选美的决赛。祖父、父母、舅舅和几乎不说话的哥哥挤上一辆爱抛锚的面包车，赶在比赛前上路。
plot_en: The Hoover family gets word that their younger daughter Olive has reached the finals of a children’s beauty pageant in California. Grandfather, parents, uncle, and a brother who barely speaks pile into a van that keeps breaking down, and set off to make the contest.

plot: 高中生威廉被一家摇滚杂志派去跟随一支还没红的乐队巡演。吉他手、追随乐队的佩妮，和这一路上的采访，都比他准备好的要乱。
plot_en: A rock magazine sends the high-schooler William on the road with a band that is not famous yet. The guitarist, Penny, who follows the band, and the interviews along the way are all messier than he was ready for.

plot: 杰西在巴黎的书店为上一本书签售，席琳出现了。距离他飞回美国只剩几个小时，两个人沿着塞纳河走路、说话。
plot_en: Jesse is signing his last book in a Paris bookshop when Céline appears. He has a few hours before his flight back to the United States. The two of them walk along the Seine and talk.

plot: 巴里卖特制活塞，不会跟人聊天，七个姐姐不停打电话来羞辱他。他先被一通诈骗电话搅进去，然后认识了同样笨拙的莉娜。
plot_en: Barry sells novelty plungers, cannot talk to people, and has seven sisters who call to humiliate him. He is first dragged in by a phone scam, and then meets Lena, who is awkward in the same way.

plot: 指挥家莉迪亚·塔尔处在事业顶上，正准备在柏林录制马勒。一个昔日学徒的死讯传来，她和年轻人的关系、她在乐团里的权威，一起开始松动。
plot_en: The conductor Lydia Tár is at the top of her career, preparing to record Mahler in Berlin. News arrives that a former protégée has died. Her relationships with young people, and her authority in the orchestra, start to come loose together.

plot: 塞思和埃文快要高中毕业，想在同学的派对上把酒带到喜欢的女孩面前。朋友福格尔弄到一张假警察证件，被两个真警察拉去办差。
plot_en: Seth and Evan are about to finish high school and want to bring alcohol to a classmate’s party, in front of the girls they like. Their friend Fogell gets a fake police ID and is pulled into a shift by two real officers.

plot: 周慕云和苏丽珍先后搬进相邻的公寓，发现各自的配偶有了外遇。两个人开始频繁见面，把话停在越界之前。
plot_en: Chow Mo-wan and Su Li-zhen move, one after the other, into neighboring apartments and discover that their spouses are having an affair. The two of them start meeting often, and stop the conversation before it crosses the line.

plot: 父母离婚后，梅森跟着母亲在德州一次次搬家。继父进来又离开，父亲偶尔出现，他自己慢慢有了女朋友，直到离开家去上大学。
plot_en: After his parents divorce, Mason moves around Texas with his mother. Stepfathers arrive and leave, his father shows up now and then, and he slowly gets a girlfriend, until he leaves home for college.

plot: 民谣歌手卢埃林在纽约过冬，搭档刚刚自杀，经纪人也不肯再推他的唱片。他睡在朋友的沙发上，跑一场又一场赚不到钱的演出。
plot_en: The folk singer Llewyn is getting through a New York winter. His partner has just killed himself, and his manager will not push his record anymore. He sleeps on friends’ couches and plays one unpaid gig after another.

plot: 退休的音乐教师乔治和安娜住在巴黎的公寓里。安娜一次中风之后右半边身体失灵，乔治把护工、女儿和医院都挡在外面，自己照顾她。
plot_en: Georges and Anne, retired music teachers, live in a Paris apartment. After a stroke, the right side of Anne’s body fails. Georges keeps the carers, their daughter, and the hospital outside, and looks after her himself.

plot: 圣地亚哥电视台的主播罗恩·勃艮第和他的班子独占着黄金时段。台里派来女记者维罗妮卡，和罗恩争同一个位子。
plot_en: Ron Burgundy and his crew have the prime-time desk at a San Diego station to themselves. The station sends in the reporter Veronica, and she and Ron compete for the same job.

plot: 物理学家奥本海默受邀领导洛斯阿拉莫斯的原子弹研制。炸弹做成之后，电影转到多年后的一场听证：他的忠诚、他的婚姻，以及他是否还能接触国家机密。
plot_en: The physicist Oppenheimer is asked to lead the building of the atomic bomb at Los Alamos. After the bomb is made, the film moves to a hearing years later: his loyalty, his marriage, and whether he can still be trusted with state secrets.

plot: 杰克回忆在德州的童年：严厉的父亲、温柔的母亲，和弟弟的死。这些家里的片段被放到宇宙形成、生命出现的画面之间。
plot_en: Jack remembers a childhood in Texas: a severe father, a gentle mother, and the death of his brother. Those scenes from the house are set between images of the universe forming and of life appearing.

plot: 萨缪尔死在法国山间小屋外的雪地里。妻子桑德拉说事发时自己在外面，视力不好的儿子在屋里。法庭要弄清他是自己跌下去的，还是被推的。
plot_en: Samuel is found dead in the snow outside a chalet in the French mountains. His wife Sandra says she was away when it happened. Their son, who does not see well, was inside. The court has to decide whether he fell or was pushed.

plot: 坦嫩鲍姆家的三个孩子小时候都是天才，长大后一个比一个停摆。多年不管家的父亲罗耶尔谎称自己快死了，搬回来住。
plot_en: The three Tenenbaum children were prodigies and, as adults, have each stalled. Their father Royal, who has ignored the family for years, claims he is dying and moves back in.

plot: 十一岁的索菲和父亲卡勒姆在土耳其的度假村里游泳、打牌、看别人唱歌。多年以后，成年的索菲翻看这次旅行留下的录像带。
plot_en: Eleven-year-old Sophie and her father Calum swim, play cards, and watch other people sing at a holiday village in Turkey. Years later, the adult Sophie goes back through the videotapes from that trip.

plot: 世界上已经十八年没有婴儿出生。前活动分子西奥被旧识找来，护送一个忽然怀孕的年轻难民，穿过英国的检查站。
plot_en: No baby has been born in the world for eighteen years. Theo, a former activist, is asked by an old acquaintance to escort a young refugee who has suddenly become pregnant through the checkpoints of Britain.

plot: 一个外形是女人的存在开着货车在苏格兰的公路上行驶，向单身男人问路，再把他们带上车。被带走的人没有再出现。她重复这件事，直到自己开始离开原来的路线。
plot_en: A being in the shape of a woman drives a van along the roads of Scotland, asks men who are alone for directions, and takes them into the van. The people who are taken do not appear again. She repeats this until she starts to leave the route.

plot: 罗马将军马克西姆斯打完仗，被新皇帝康茂德下令处死，家人也遭了毒手。他活下来，被卖成角斗士，一路打回罗马的竞技场。
plot_en: The Roman general Maximus finishes a war and is ordered killed by the new emperor, Commodus. His family is killed too. He survives, is sold as a gladiator, and fights his way back to the arena in Rome.

plot: 作家阿拉贝拉在一个晚上被下药、侵害，之后她要靠碎片把那晚重新拼起来。朋友、约会和创作都不再能用原来的说法解释。
plot_en: The writer Arabella is drugged and assaulted one night, and afterward has to put that night back together from fragments. Friends, dates, and the work can no longer be explained in the old way.
playbill: 米凯拉·科尔根据自己被性侵的经历创作，她编剧、主演，也参与导演。题材沉重，但剧本不按受害者模板写：有幽默，有复杂的友情，也有模糊的道德问题。共 12 集，后劲很大，科尔凭此拿下艾美编剧奖。
playbill_en: Michaela Coel made it from her own sexual assault. She wrote it, stars in it, and directed some of it. The subject is heavy, and the script does not follow a victim template: there is humor, a complicated friendship, and moral questions that stay unclear. Twelve episodes. It stays with you. Coel won the Emmy for writing.

plot: BBC 的十一集自然系列，从极地、洞穴、平原到深海，记录当时的摄影还很难靠近的动物行为。爱登堡的旁白把景观说成一座还在运转的系统。
plot_en: The BBC’s eleven-part nature series, from the poles, caves, and plains to the deep ocean, records animal behavior that the cameras of the time could barely get near. Attenborough’s narration treats the landscape as a system that is still running.
playbill: BBC 自然纪录片，耗时五年拍摄，用高清镜头拍下雪豹、深海生物和动物大迁徙等罕见画面。大卫·爱登堡的解说沉稳动听。它定下了现代自然纪录片的视觉标准，最好用大屏幕看。
playbill_en: A BBC nature documentary, filmed over five years, using high-definition cameras on snow leopards, deep-sea life, and the great migrations, images that were rarely seen. David Attenborough’s narration is steady and good to listen to. It set the visual standard for modern nature documentaries. It is best on a large screen.

plot: 山姆在姐姐去世后留在堪萨斯老家，觉得自己是这里的外人。一个合唱团和朋友乔尔让她重新开口唱歌，也重新学习怎么待在一个小镇里。
plot_en: After her sister dies, Sam stays in her hometown in Kansas and feels like an outsider there. A choir and her friend Joel get her singing again, and get her learning how to stay in a small town.
playbill: 中年女人山姆在姐姐去世后留在堪萨斯老家，一直找不到归属感，直到加入一群小镇「边缘人」的歌唱聚会。节奏慢，没有大反转，但写友情和孤独非常温柔。布里吉特·埃弗里特开口唱歌的段落很动人。
playbill_en: Sam, a middle-aged woman, stays in her Kansas hometown after her sister’s death and cannot find a place she belongs, until she joins a singing group of the town’s outsiders. It is slow, with no big reversal, and it is very gentle about friendship and loneliness. The passages where Bridget Everett sings are moving.

plot: 1960 年代的麦迪逊大道，创意总监唐·德雷珀替客户发明欲望，自己则靠一个偷来的名字过活。办公室里的性别、酒和晋升，比广告本身更忙。
plot_en: On Madison Avenue in the 1960s, the creative director Don Draper invents desires for clients and lives under a name he stole. Gender, drink, and promotion in the office are busier than the advertising.
playbill: 1960 年代的纽约广告业，西装、烟酒和办公室政治都拍得极讲究。主线是唐·德雷珀的身份之谜，佩吉从秘书升为文案的那条线同样好看，十年的社会变化都藏在背景里。节奏慢，适合细看；连续四年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
playbill_en: New York advertising in the 1960s. The suits, the cigarettes, the drinks, and the office politics are all made with great care. The main line is the mystery of Don Draper’s identity. Peggy’s rise from secretary to copywriter is just as good to watch, and a decade of social change sits in the background. It is slow, and it rewards attention. It won the Emmy for best drama four years running.

plot: 每一集从一个生活题目开始，比如如何小幅交谈或如何扔掉电池。威尔逊拿着摄像机在纽约街头走，旁白很快就偏离教程，碰到真正的人。
plot_en: Each episode starts from a subject in ordinary life, such as how to make small talk or how to throw out batteries. Wilson walks the streets of New York with a camera, and the voice-over soon leaves the tutorial and meets actual people.
playbill: 每集看起来是一份生活教程，比如怎样闲聊、怎样找车位，结果约翰·威尔逊拍下的纽约街景越跑越偏。自言自语的旁白，配上随手拍下的街头片段，常常好笑又意外地感人。不靠写好的笑话，靠观察和剪辑。
playbill_en: Each episode looks like a how-to: how to make small talk, how to find a parking space. What John Wilson films of the New York street then runs off in another direction. A muttered narration over footage grabbed in the street is often funny and, unexpectedly, moving. It does not rely on written jokes. It relies on looking and on the edit.

plot: 每一季换一座白莲花度假酒店，开场先知道这周会死一个人，再回头看客人如何把服务员、本地人和彼此当成假期的一部分。
plot_en: Each season moves to another White Lotus hotel. The opening tells you someone will die this week, and then goes back to watch how the guests treat the staff, the local people, and each other as part of the holiday.
playbill: 每季换一座豪华度假村和一批有钱游客。开头先告诉你有人死了，再倒回去看这一周发生了什么。它讽刺有钱人的傲慢和空虚，也拍服务员的处境。第一季在夏威夷，第二季在西西里，第三季在泰国，各季可以单独看。
playbill_en: Each season changes the luxury resort and the batch of rich guests. It tells you at the start that someone has died, then goes back over the week. It satirizes the arrogance and the emptiness of the rich, and it also films the position of the staff. The first season is in Hawaii, the second in Sicily, the third in Thailand. The seasons can be watched on their own.

plot: 宾夕法尼亚小镇警探梅尔·希恩调查一名年轻母亲的死，同时应付离婚、丧子和孙子的监护权。她认识每一个嫌疑人，因为他们都是邻居。
plot_en: Mare Sheehan, a detective in a small Pennsylvania town, investigates the death of a young mother while dealing with a divorce, the loss of her son, and custody of her grandson. She knows every suspect, because they are neighbors.
playbill: 小镇女警探调查一位年轻母亲被杀的案子，同时还要面对离婚、儿子自杀和孙子的监护权问题。悬疑线扎实，家庭戏更动人。凯特·温斯莱特凭此拿下艾美限定剧女主角。七集，结局反转很多。
playbill_en: A small-town detective investigates the murder of a young mother, and at the same time faces a divorce, her son’s suicide, and custody of her grandson. The mystery is solid. The family scenes are more moving. Kate Winslet won the Emmy for lead actress in a limited series. Seven episodes, and a lot of turns at the end.

plot: 拉斯维加斯老牌笑匠黛博拉·万斯事业下滑，被迫和被行业赶走的年轻写手艾娃合作。两个人互相看不起，又都需要对方的句子。
plot_en: Deborah Vance, a long-running comic in Las Vegas, is slipping, and is forced to work with Ava, a young writer the industry has pushed out. They look down on each other, and each of them needs the other’s sentences.
playbill: 拉斯维加斯的老牌女笑星，和一个被行业封杀的年轻写手合作写段子。两人一开始互相看不上，后来成了最懂彼此的人。珍·斯玛特凭此多次拿下艾美喜剧类女主角，第三季还获得最佳喜剧剧集。
playbill_en: An established woman comic in Las Vegas writes material with a young writer the industry has blacklisted. They cannot stand each other at first, and later become the people who understand each other best. Jean Smart has won the Emmy for lead actress in a comedy more than once for it, and the third season also won best comedy series.

plot: 1600 年的日本，英国水手布莱克索恩的船漂到岸上，正赶上大名之间决定谁来统治的前夜。翻译真理夫人把两套语言、两套忠诚都扛在身上。
plot_en: In Japan in 1600, the English sailor Blackthorne’s ship drifts ashore on the eve of the lords deciding who will rule. Lady Mariko, the translator, carries both languages and both loyalties.
playbill: 1600 年的日本，战国末期，一名英国领航员漂流上岸，卷入大名之间的权力斗争。台词大部分是日语，服装、礼仪和政治博弈都很讲究。真田广之主演兼任制片，第一季拿下创纪录的 18 项艾美奖。
playbill_en: Japan in 1600, at the end of the warring states. An English navigator washes ashore and is pulled into the struggle among the lords. Most of the dialogue is in Japanese. The costume, the etiquette, and the political maneuvering are all careful. Hiroyuki Sanada stars and produces. The first season won a record 18 Emmys.

plot: 费舍尔家在洛杉矶经营殡仪馆。每一集以一次死亡开场，活着的人则继续吵架、相爱和把遗体推进房间。
plot_en: The Fisher family runs a funeral home in Los Angeles. Each episode opens with a death. The living go on arguing, loving, and wheeling the body into the room.
playbill: 一家人经营殡仪馆，每集开头都会死一个人，死亡成了日常话题。它真正讲的是活着的人怎样面对失去、性取向和家庭关系。最后几分钟的蒙太奇，被公认为电视剧史上最好的结局之一。
playbill_en: A family runs a funeral home. Someone dies at the start of each episode, and death becomes an ordinary subject. What it is really about is how the living face loss, sexuality, and the family. The montage in the last few minutes is widely taken as one of the best endings in the history of television.

plot: 名厨卡米回到芝加哥，接管哥哥自杀后留下的牛肉三明治店。厨房又吵又挤，他想把它做成一家真正的餐厅，家人却还停在丧事里。
plot_en: The chef Carmy comes back to Chicago to take over the beef-sandwich shop his brother left when he killed himself. The kitchen is loud and cramped. He wants to make it a real restaurant. The family is still inside the funeral.
playbill: 顶级厨师回到芝加哥，接手已故哥哥留下的三明治店。厨房戏非常紧张，镜头和对白像在打仗。第一季第七集一镜到底；第二季的《鱼》是一场全家圣诞晚餐的灾难现场。
playbill_en: A top chef comes back to Chicago to take over the sandwich shop his late brother left. The kitchen scenes are extremely tense. The camera and the dialogue feel like a fight. Episode seven of the first season is a single take. “Fishes,” in the second season, is a family Christmas dinner going to pieces.

plot: 高中化学老师沃尔特·怀特确诊肺癌，为了给家人留下钱，与前学生杰西合伙制造冰毒。一条房车里的生计，慢慢变成一座他不肯交出的帝国。
plot_en: Walter White, a high-school chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with lung cancer. To leave money for his family he partners with his former student Jesse and starts making meth. A living made in a trailer slowly becomes an empire he will not hand over.
playbill: 看一个普通人怎样一步步变成毒枭，每次转变都有前因，不是突然黑化。克兰斯顿凭这个角色拿了四座艾美剧情类男主角。前两季稍慢，越往后越紧；第五季的《奥兹曼迪亚斯》常被评为美剧史上最好的单集之一。
playbill_en: You watch an ordinary man become a drug lord, and each turn has a cause. He does not simply go bad. Cranston won four Emmys for best actor in a drama for the role. The first two seasons are a little slow, and it tightens after that. “Ozymandias,” in the fifth season, is often called one of the best single episodes in American television.

plot: 维斯特洛的几个家族争夺铁王座，北境的长城外面还有一场被大多数人当成传说的冬天。改编自乔治·R·R·马丁的小说，贵族的联姻和战场用的是同一套规则。
plot_en: Several houses in Westeros contest the Iron Throne. Beyond the Wall in the north, a winter that most people treat as legend is also coming. Adapted from the novels of George R. R. Martin, the nobles’ marriages and the battles run on the same set of rules.
playbill: 奇幻外壳下是一部权谋剧。主角随时可能死掉，谁都不安全，这是前几季最抓人的地方。制作规模接近电影，《黑水之战》《私生子之战》都是剧集战争场面的标杆。最后一季口碑大跌，前六季仍然值得看。
playbill_en: Under the fantasy is a show about power. Lead characters can die at any time, and no one is safe. That is what made the early seasons grip. The scale of the production is close to a film. “Blackwater” and “The Battle of the Bastards” set a standard for war on television. The last season’s reputation collapsed. The first six are still worth watching.

plot: 迈阿密警队的血迹分析师德克斯特遵守养父留下的准则，只杀死漏网的杀人犯。白天他学着做普通人，夜里把另一套生活收进冷藏袋。
plot_en: Dexter, a blood-spatter analyst for the Miami police, follows a code his adoptive father left him and kills only murderers who got away. By day he learns how to be an ordinary person. At night he packs the other life into freezer bags.
playbill: 迈阿密警局的血迹分析师德克斯特，私下是只杀坏人的连环杀手。前四季最好，第四季的「三位一体杀手」是全剧高峰。后几季明显下滑，原版结局评价很差。
playbill_en: Dexter, a blood-spatter analyst for the Miami police, is privately a serial killer who only kills people he judges guilty. The first four seasons are the best. The Trinity Killer, in season four, is the peak. The later seasons drop off, and the original ending was badly received.

plot: 1870 年代，达科他领地的死木镇还没有正式的法，金矿、酒馆和妓院先到了。警长塞思·布洛克和酒馆老板艾尔·斯韦尔恩根商量这座镇子归谁管。
plot_en: In the 1870s the town of Deadwood, in the Dakota Territory, has no formal law yet. The gold, the saloons, and the brothels arrive first. Sheriff Seth Bullock and the saloon owner Al Swearengen negotiate who runs the town.
playbill: 1870 年代南达科他的淘金小镇还没有法律，秩序靠酒馆老板和警长一点点建立。台词半古典、半粗口，像莎士比亚写的西部片。伊恩·麦柯肖恩演的艾尔是全剧灵魂。只拍了三季就被砍，2019 年出了一部电影收尾。
playbill_en: A gold-rush town in 1870s South Dakota has no law. Order is built, a piece at a time, by a saloon owner and a sheriff. The dialogue is half classical and half obscenity, like a western written by Shakespeare. Ian McShane’s Al is the soul of the show. It was cancelled after three seasons. A film in 2019 closed it.

plot: 中情局军官嘉莉·马蒂森认定，被救回来的海军陆战队员布罗迪已经倒向敌人。她的判断力极强，也受躁郁症左右，局里没有人愿意完全相信她。
plot_en: The CIA officer Carrie Mathison becomes convinced that Brody, a Marine who has been brought home, has turned. Her judgment is extremely sharp, and it is also steered by bipolar disorder. No one at the agency is willing to believe her completely.
playbill: 一名被俘多年的美军士兵归国，中情局女特工嘉莉怀疑他已被策反。第一季把「他到底是不是」的悬念吊得非常好。克莱尔·丹妮丝演的嘉莉既有天才般的判断力，也受双相障碍困扰，是全剧的核心。
playbill_en: A Marine comes home after years in captivity, and the CIA officer Carrie suspects he has been turned. The first season holds the question “is he or isn’t he” very well. Claire Danes’s Carrie has a near-genius judgment and is also living with bipolar disorder. She is the center of the show.

plot: 格里高利·豪斯是诊断科的负责人，专接别的医生放弃的病例。他确信病人在撒谎，自己则靠止疼药维持一条受伤的腿和更重的脾气。
plot_en: Gregory House runs a department of diagnostics and takes the cases other doctors have given up. He is sure the patient is lying. He himself stays upright on painkillers, for an injured leg and a worse temper.
playbill: 天才医生豪斯脾气古怪、嘴毒、对止痛药上瘾，专门诊断别人解决不了的病例，每集都像一个医学版侦探故事。休·劳瑞是英国人，却把美式口音演得毫无破绽。
playbill_en: House is a brilliant doctor, rude, mean, and addicted to painkillers. He diagnoses the cases no one else can solve, and each episode is a detective story in a hospital. Hugh Laurie is British, and the American accent has no cracks in it.

plot: 洛杉矶法明顿区的维克·麦基带领特警小队，用非法的办法换来街头成绩。试播集里的一桩谋杀没有被忘掉，它在后面七年里一直向他收利息。
plot_en: Vic Mackey leads a strike team in Los Angeles’s Farmington district and buys results on the street with illegal methods. A murder in the pilot is not forgotten. For the next seven years it keeps collecting interest from him.
playbill: 洛杉矶警察维克·麦基带着小队以暴制暴、私吞毒资，试播集结尾他就亲手杀了一名同事。整部剧像一根慢慢收紧的绳索，看他能不能逃过报应。结局被很多人认为是电视史上最好的结局之一。
playbill_en: The Los Angeles cop Vic Mackey and his team answer violence with violence and skim drug money. At the end of the pilot he kills a colleague with his own hands. The whole series is a rope slowly tightening, to see whether he can get out from under what he owes. The ending is widely taken as one of the best endings in television.

plot: 普里切特一家三支，以假纪录片的方式过同一座城市里的日子：再婚、同志伴侣和传统郊区家庭，麻烦都出在晚饭之前。
plot_en: Three branches of the Pritchett family get through their days in the same city, shot as a fake documentary: a second marriage, a same-sex couple, and a conventional suburban family. The trouble all arrives before dinner.
playbill: 伪纪录片形式拍三个有亲戚关系的家庭：老夫少妻、同性伴侣和普通的三口之家。每集半小时，笑点稳定，很适合全家一起看。连续五年拿下艾美最佳喜剧剧集。
playbill_en: A mockumentary of three related households: an older man with a younger wife, a same-sex couple, and an ordinary family of three. Half an hour an episode, the jokes are steady, and it is easy to watch together. It won the Emmy for best comedy five years in a row.

plot: 国会党鞭弗兰克·安德伍德没能得到许诺的职位，于是开始逐个清除挡路的人。他不时转头对观众说明下一步。妻子克莱尔经营的是另一套更冷的政治。
plot_en: Frank Underwood, the party whip in Congress, does not get the job he was promised, and starts removing the people in his way, one by one. Now and then he turns to the audience and explains the next step. His wife Claire runs a colder kind of politics.
playbill: 国会议员弗兰克·安德伍德没当上国务卿，开始一路设局往上爬，还常常对着镜头直接跟观众说话。它是 Netflix 第一部真正有影响力的原创大剧。前两季最紧凑；主演凯文·斯派西因丑闻被解约，最后一季没有他。
playbill_en: The congressman Frank Underwood is passed over for secretary of state and starts scheming his way up. He often speaks straight to the camera. It was Netflix’s first original series that really mattered. The first two seasons are the tightest. Kevin Spacey was dropped after the scandal, and the last season is without him.

plot: 检察官彼得·弗洛里克因性丑闻和贪腐下台，妻子艾丽西娅十三年后回到律师事务所。案件每周进来，公司政治和她自己的名字则慢慢变得更重要。
plot_en: The prosecutor Peter Florrick falls over a sex scandal and corruption. Thirteen years later his wife Alicia returns to a law firm. A case comes in every week. The politics of the firm, and her own name, slowly become more important.
playbill: 丈夫因丑闻入狱后，艾丽西娅重返律所当律师。每集一个案子，但律所政治、竞选和婚姻线才是长期看点。在法律剧里，它少见地关注科技、政治和媒体。
playbill_en: After her husband goes to prison over a scandal, Alicia goes back to a firm as a lawyer. There is a case each episode, but the long-term interest is the politics of the firm, the campaigns, and the marriage. Among legal shows, it is unusual in paying attention to technology, politics, and the media.

plot: 联邦法警雷兰·吉文斯因开枪过快被调回肯塔基老家。他要对付的不只是当地罪犯，还有跟他一起长大、现在布道又贩毒的博伊德·克劳德。
plot_en: The federal marshal Raylan Givens is sent back to his home in Kentucky for shooting too quickly. He has to deal not only with the local criminals but with Boyd Crowder, who grew up with him and now preaches and sells drugs.
playbill: 改编自埃尔莫尔·伦纳德的小说，联邦法警雷兰回到肯塔基老家执法。主角冷静、幽默，拔枪极快；对手博伊德能说会道。南方犯罪氛围浓，对白很有味道，最后一季的结局很经典。
playbill_en: Adapted from Elmore Leonard. The federal marshal Raylan comes home to Kentucky to enforce the law. He is calm, funny, and very fast with a gun. His opposite, Boyd, can talk. The Southern crime atmosphere is thick, the dialogue has a flavor, and the last season’s ending is a classic.

plot: 巴尔的摩的缉毒组盯上毒贩斯特林格·贝尔和奥马尔。五季分别走过街头、码头、市政厅、学校和报社，警察只是这座城市的其中一条线。
plot_en: A narcotics unit in Baltimore sets its sights on the dealer Stringer Bell and on Omar. Five seasons pass through the street, the docks, city hall, the schools, and the newspaper. The police are only one line in the city.
playbill: 不是一案一结的警匪剧。五季分别拍毒品街头、码头工会、市政选举、公立学校和报社，拼起来是一整座城市怎样失灵。主创西蒙当过巴尔的摩记者，很多细节来自真实案例。开头人物多、俚语多，撑过前三四集就会上瘾。
playbill_en: It is not a cop show that closes a case each week. Five seasons cover the drug corners, the dockworkers’ union, a city election, the public schools, and a newspaper. Put together, they are how a whole city fails. The creator, Simon, was a reporter in Baltimore, and a lot of the detail comes from real cases. There are many people at the start, and a lot of slang. Get through the first three or four episodes and it takes hold.

plot: 一群陌生人被放到偏远地带，分组生活、赢得比赛，再在部落会议上把人投票送走。最后留下的人拿走奖金。体力很快就不如联盟重要。
plot_en: A group of strangers is put in a remote place, lives in teams, wins competitions, and votes people out at tribal council. The last one left takes the money. Physical strength soon matters less than alliances.
playbill: 真人秀的鼻祖之一：一群人被丢到荒岛上，分部落比赛、投票淘汰，最后一人赢走百万美元。真正决定输赢的是结盟和背叛。已经播了四十多季，至今仍在更新。
playbill_en: One of the originals of reality television: a group of people is dropped on a deserted island, competes in tribes, votes each other out, and the last person wins a million dollars. What actually decides it is alliances and betrayal. It has run more than forty seasons and is still on.

plot: 承包商丹尼和店主艾米在停车场互相按了喇叭，一场路怒升级成彼此生活的全面破坏。两个人都在勉强维持一个看起来还行的自己。
plot_en: The contractor Danny and the shop owner Amy honk at each other in a parking lot, and a bout of road rage turns into the wrecking of each other’s lives. Both of them are barely holding up a self that still looks all right.
playbill: 两个陌生人在停车场起了路怒冲突，之后报复不断升级。黑色幽默很强，底下是亚裔家庭、阶层焦虑和孤独。史蒂文·元和黄阿丽演得很好，十集节奏紧凑，共拿下 8 项艾美奖。
playbill_en: Two strangers get into a road-rage fight in a parking lot, and the revenge keeps escalating. The black humor is strong. Under it are Asian families, class anxiety, and loneliness. Steven Yeun and Ali Wong are very good in it. Ten episodes, tightly paced, and eight Emmys.

plot: 被取消律师资格的杰夫·温格进入一所社区大学，凑出了一个什么课都一起上的学习小组。剧经常整集改成另一种类型：动作片、纪录片、八比特游戏。
plot_en: Jeff Winger, disbarred, enrolls at a community college and assembles a study group that takes every class together. The show will spend a whole episode as another genre: an action movie, a documentary, an 8-bit game.
playbill: 一群背景各异的人在社区大学组成学习小组。它常常整集戏仿各种类型片，比如彩弹枪大战、黑帮片和纪录片。第二、三季最强；后期主创被解雇又回归，质量起伏较大。
playbill_en: A group of people with nothing in common form a study group at a community college. Whole episodes parody a genre: paintball, a gangster film, a documentary. Seasons two and three are the strongest. The creator was later fired and then brought back, and the quality swings.

plot: 劳拉·帕尔默的案子过去二十五年，库珀探员要回到双峰，可他并不是完整地回来。十八集里有原子弹、路边的房子，和一段几乎不动的等待。
plot_en: Twenty-five years after the Laura Palmer case, Agent Cooper has to get back to Twin Peaks, and he does not come back whole. Across eighteen episodes there is an atomic bomb, a house by the road, and a stretch of waiting in which almost nothing moves.
playbill: 大卫·林奇在原版播出 25 年后拍的续作，共 18 集。别期待普通续集，它几乎是一部 18 小时的实验电影。第八集的原子弹试爆段落尤其惊人，喜欢林奇的人会非常着迷。
playbill_en: David Lynch’s continuation, made 25 years after the original. Eighteen episodes. Do not expect an ordinary sequel. It is close to an eighteen-hour experimental film. The atomic-bomb passage in episode eight is especially astonishing. People who like Lynch will be absorbed.

plot: 机器人赛昂人几乎灭绝人类，残余的舰队在指挥官阿达玛和总统罗斯林带领下寻找传说中的地球。敌人长得和人一样，也可以爱、可以信仰。
plot_en: The Cylon robots nearly wipe out humanity. What is left of the fleet, under Commander Adama and President Roslin, searches for a legendary Earth. The enemy looks human, and can love, and can believe.
playbill: 机器人赛昂人几乎灭绝人类，幸存者跟着一艘战舰逃亡。表面是太空科幻，实际讨论战争、宗教、民主和恐怖主义，很多情节明显影射 9·11 之后的美国。前两季最强。
playbill_en: The Cylons nearly destroy humanity, and the survivors flee with a warship. It looks like space science fiction and is really about war, religion, democracy, and terrorism. A lot of it clearly shadows the United States after September 11. The first two seasons are the strongest.

plot: 过气情景喜剧演员瓦莱丽·切里什答应拍一部关于自己复出的真人秀，于是生活被第二次拍摄。她要讨好更年轻的编剧，也要在镜头前维持「还没过时」。
plot_en: Valerie Cherish, a sitcom actress past her prime, agrees to film a reality show about her comeback, so her life is filmed a second time. She has to please a younger writer, and keep up, in front of the camera, the appearance of not being finished.
playbill: 丽莎·库卓（《老友记》里的菲比）演一个过气女演员，答应让真人秀全程跟拍她的复出。笑点来自她拼命讨好镜头又不断出丑，尴尬也心酸。2005 年只播一季就被砍，多年后又拍了续季。
playbill_en: Lisa Kudrow, Phoebe on Friends, plays an actress past her prime who agrees to let a reality show follow her comeback. The jokes come from her straining to please the camera and constantly humiliating herself. It is embarrassing and sad. It ran one season in 2005 and was cancelled, then came back years later.

plot: 职业外交官凯特·怀勒临时出任美国驻英国大使，到任时一场危机已经烧到大使馆门口。丈夫哈尔也是外交官，帮忙和添乱用的是同一套本事。
plot_en: Kate Wyler, a career diplomat, is suddenly made the American ambassador to Britain, and arrives with a crisis already burning at the embassy door. Her husband Hal is a diplomat too. The same skills are used to help and to make trouble.
playbill: 美国职业外交官凯特被临时任命为驻英大使，同时还得处理和丈夫的婚姻危机。国际危机节奏快、对白密，像一部职场版政治惊悚剧。凯丽·拉塞尔把这个角色演得又聪明又狼狈。
playbill_en: Kate, a career American diplomat, is suddenly appointed ambassador to Britain, and at the same time has to deal with the crisis in her marriage. The international crises move fast and the dialogue is dense. It is like a workplace political thriller. Keri Russell plays the role as both sharp and a mess.

plot: 菲尔德为真人建造等比例的场景，让他们把一场艰难的谈话先排练一遍。计划越做越完整，最后连他自己的生活也被放进彩排。
plot_en: Fielder builds full-scale sets for real people so they can rehearse a difficult conversation first. The plan gets more complete, until his own life is put into the rehearsal.
playbill: 内森·菲尔德帮普通人「彩排」人生中的关键时刻，比如向朋友坦白一个谎言，为此不惜搭出一比一的酒吧场景。节目越往后越失控，连他自己也被卷了进去。好笑、诡异，也会让人不安。
playbill_en: Nathan Fielder helps ordinary people “rehearse” a crucial moment, such as confessing a lie to a friend, and will build a one-to-one copy of a bar to do it. As the show goes on it gets out of control, and he himself is pulled in. Funny, eerie, and unsettling.

plot: 宾夕法尼亚一家纸业公司的斯克兰顿分公司，经理迈克尔·斯科特把办公室当成自己的舞台。假纪录片拍下销售、恋爱，以及谁都不想参加的派对。
plot_en: At the Scranton branch of a paper company in Pennsylvania, the manager Michael Scott treats the office as his stage. A fake documentary records the sales, the romances, and the parties no one wants to attend.
playbill: 伪纪录片形式拍一家纸业公司的日常，老板迈克尔每次想当好人都会搞砸。吉姆和帕姆的感情线是很多人坚持看下去的原因。第一季还在模仿英版，从第二季开始找到自己的风格，前七季最好。
playbill_en: A mockumentary of daily life at a paper company. Every time the boss, Michael, tries to be a good person, he wrecks it. Jim and Pam’s relationship is the reason a lot of people stay. The first season is still imitating the British original. From the second season it finds its own style. The first seven seasons are the best.

plot: 酒吧里的喜剧演员唐尼对一名女顾客释放了善意，对方开始长期跟踪他。剧情随后转向唐尼自己隐瞒多年的受侵害经历，以及他为何没有立刻切断这段关系。
plot_en: Donny, a comedian working in a bar, offers a kindness to a woman at the bar, and she begins stalking him for a long time. The story then turns to the abuse Donny has hidden for years, and to why he did not cut the relationship off at once.
playbill: 根据理查德·加德的真实经历改编：一个失意的喜剧演员被一个女人长期跟踪骚扰。前半段像惊悚剧，后半段揭开他过去遭受性侵的创伤，非常沉重。表演极真实，杰西卡·甘宁演的跟踪者让人难忘。
playbill_en: Based on Richard Gadd’s own experience: a struggling comedian is stalked by a woman. The first half plays like a thriller. The second half uncovers the sexual abuse in his past, and it is very heavy. The performances feel real. Jessica Gunning’s stalker stays with you.

plot: 十三岁的杰米在家中被逮捕，罪名是杀害一名同学。四集分别跟着拘捕、学校、心理评估和这个家庭的余波，每一集都是一个不中断的长镜头。
plot_en: Thirteen-year-old Jamie is arrested at home, accused of killing a classmate. The four episodes follow the arrest, the school, a psychological evaluation, and the aftermath for the family. Each episode is one uninterrupted shot.
playbill: 每集一镜到底，四集讲一个 13 岁男孩被控谋杀后的四个时刻。它关注网络厌女文化怎样影响青少年，以及父母和学校为什么没有察觉。第一次演戏的欧文·库珀在第三集与心理医生的对手戏尤其惊人。
playbill_en: Each episode is a single take. Four episodes cover four moments after a 13-year-old boy is charged with murder. It is about how online misogyny reaches teenagers, and why the parents and the school did not see it. Owen Cooper, acting for the first time, is especially startling in the third episode, opposite the psychologist.

plot: 匹兹堡一家医院的急诊室，一集大约是一个小时的班。主治医生罗比带着实习生处理接连进来的病人，私人的事只能插在两副担架之间。
plot_en: The emergency room of a hospital in Pittsburgh. An episode is about an hour of a shift. The attending, Robbie, takes the interns through the patients who keep coming in. Private matters can only be fitted between two stretchers.
playbill: 一集大致对应急诊室里一小时的班，整季就是一个 15 小时的班次。不靠恋爱戏撑场，靠快速而真实的抢救流程，以及医护人员的疲惫和创伤。《急诊室的故事》里的诺亚·怀尔担任主演，2025 年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集和男主角。
playbill_en: An episode is roughly one hour of a shift in an emergency room, and the season is one fifteen-hour shift. It does not lean on a romance. It leans on a fast, believable sequence of treatment, and on how tired and damaged the staff are. Noah Wyle, from ER, is the lead. In 2025 it won the Emmys for best drama and lead actor.

plot: 五个经营费城酒吧的人自私、短视，并且真心相信自己是房间里最受委屈的那个。每一集的计划都会因为他们的性格失败。
plot_en: Five people running a bar in Philadelphia are selfish, shortsighted, and sincerely believe they are the most put-upon person in the room. Every episode’s plan fails because of who they are.
playbill: 五个自私又愚蠢的人经营一家费城爱尔兰酒吧，每集都在想坏主意，然后彻底失败。他们几乎从不成长，这正是笑点所在。已经播了十六季以上，是美国播出时间最长的真人情景喜剧。
playbill_en: Five selfish, stupid people run an Irish bar in Philadelphia. Each episode they think up a bad idea and then fail completely. They almost never grow up, which is the joke. It has run more than sixteen seasons, the longest-running live-action sitcom on American television.

plot: 塞琳娜·迈耶是美国副总统，日程全是没人想要的访问和随时会塌的联盟。她想当总统，幕僚想活命，每一集的危机都来自上一句随口的话。
plot_en: Selina Meyer is the vice president of the United States. The schedule is full of visits no one wants and alliances that can collapse at any moment. She wants to be president. The staff want to survive. Each episode’s crisis comes from the previous offhand sentence.
playbill: 美国副总统和她的幕僚永远在救火，政治在这里只剩甩锅、抢镜头和骂人。脏话写得极有创意，节奏快到要暂停回看。朱莉娅·路易斯-德雷弗斯凭此连拿六座艾美喜剧类女主角。
playbill_en: The vice president and her staff are always putting out fires. Politics here is only passing the blame, grabbing the camera, and swearing. The obscenities are extremely inventive, and the pace is fast enough that you will pause and go back. Julia Louis-Dreyfus won six Emmys for lead actress in a comedy for it.

plot: 斯劳一家纸业公司的区域经理戴维·布伦特接受纪录片拍摄，把管理理解成表演。蒂姆喜欢接待员唐恩，办公室里几乎没有人想被拍到。
plot_en: David Brent, the regional manager of a paper company in Slough, agrees to be filmed for a documentary and understands management as a performance. Tim likes the receptionist Dawn. Almost no one in the office wants to be filmed.
playbill: 美版的原作，只有两季加两集圣诞特辑，共 14 集。瑞奇·热维斯演的老板大卫·布伦特尴尬到让人想捂脸，伪纪录片喜剧正是从它开始流行起来。比美版更冷、更苦，也更短。
playbill_en: The original of the American version. Two seasons plus two Christmas specials, fourteen episodes. Ricky Gervais’s boss, David Brent, is embarrassing enough that you want to cover your face. The mockumentary comedy became popular from this. It is colder, more bitter, and shorter than the American version.

plot: 脱口秀演员路易在纽约带两个女儿，每一集像一段单独的短片：一场失败的约会、一次上台，或一件突然变得可怕的小事。
plot_en: The stand-up comic Louie is raising two daughters in New York. Each episode is like a short film on its own: a failed date, a set, or a small thing that suddenly becomes frightening.
playbill: 路易·C·K 自编自导自演，每集像一部短片：有时搞笑，有时伤感，有时很荒诞，影响了后来很多作者型喜剧。主创后来因性骚扰丑闻停工，有观众会因此不看。
playbill_en: Louis C.K. writes, directs, and stars. Each episode is like a short: sometimes funny, sometimes sad, sometimes absurd. It influenced a lot of later author-driven comedy. He later stopped working after sexual-harassment allegations, and some viewers will not watch it for that reason.

plot: 1912 年之后的约克郡庄园，克劳利一家和楼下的仆人被同一座房子绑在一起。继承、战争和新兴的中产，慢慢改掉楼上楼下的规矩。
plot_en: After 1912, on an estate in Yorkshire, the Crawley family and the servants downstairs are tied to the same house. Inheritance, war, and a rising middle class slowly change the rules above and below stairs.
playbill: 20 世纪初的英国贵族庄园，楼上是格兰瑟姆伯爵一家，楼下是仆人。剧情像高级家庭肥皂剧，服装、礼仪和时代变迁都拍得很好看。玛吉·史密斯演的老夫人几乎每句台词都是金句。
playbill_en: An English aristocratic house at the start of the twentieth century. Upstairs is the Earl of Grantham’s family. Downstairs are the servants. It plays like a high-end family soap. The clothes, the manners, and the change of the era are all good to look at. Maggie Smith’s dowager has a line worth keeping almost every time she speaks.

plot: 业余烘焙者在帐篷里完成签名菜、技术挑战和创意赛，周末有人回家，留下的人继续和面。竞争是真的，安慰也是赛制的一部分。
plot_en: Amateur bakers in a tent make a signature bake, a technical challenge, and a showstopper. Someone goes home on the weekend. The people who stay keep working dough. The competition is real, and so is the comfort, which is part of the format.
playbill: 业余烘焙师在帐篷里比做蛋糕、面包和甜点，每周淘汰一人。特别之处在于温和：选手会互相帮忙，评委也不刻意制造冲突。看完很可能想马上去烤点什么。
playbill_en: Amateur bakers compete in a tent at cakes, bread, and desserts, and one person is sent home each week. What is particular about it is the mildness: the contestants help each other, and the judges do not manufacture conflict on purpose. After watching it you will probably want to bake something.

plot: 艾米·杰利科在公司崩溃后去静修，回来决心成为更好的人，并向曾经伤害她的企业发起举报。她的善意经常是真的，方法经常是灾难。
plot_en: After Amy Jellicoe breaks down at her company, she goes on a retreat and comes back determined to be a better person, and to blow the whistle on the company that hurt her. Her goodwill is often real. Her methods are often a disaster.
playbill: 劳拉·邓恩演一个情绪崩溃后去疗养中心「开悟」的女人。回到公司后，她想做好人、揭发公司，却总把场面弄得很难堪。主创迈克·怀特后来做了《白莲花度假村》。只有两季，评价高，知道的人却不多。
playbill_en: Laura Dern plays a woman who has a breakdown and comes back from a retreat “enlightened.” At the company she tries to be good and to expose it, and keeps making the room unbearable. The creator, Mike White, later made The White Lotus. Two seasons, highly regarded, and not widely known.

plot: 奥利维亚·波普在华盛顿替权贵处理不能见报的危机，自己却与总统维持着一段足以掀翻白宫的关系。她的团队叫角斗士，工作是在截稿时间之前改写事实。
plot_en: Olivia Pope handles crises in Washington that cannot appear in the papers, and is herself in a relationship with the president that could bring down the White House. Her team is called the gladiators. The job is to rewrite the facts before the deadline.
playbill: 华盛顿的危机公关奥利维亚·波普替权贵摆平丑闻，自己却和总统有婚外情。剧情反转极快，几乎每集都有惊人情节，是一部节奏很爽的政治狗血剧。凯丽·华盛顿是近 40 年来第一位在美国电视网剧集担任主角的非裔女演员。
playbill_en: Olivia Pope, a crisis manager in Washington, cleans up scandals for the powerful, and is having an affair with the president. The plot turns extremely fast. Almost every episode has something astonishing. It is a political soap with a very satisfying pace. Kerry Washington was the first Black woman in nearly forty years to lead an American network series.

plot: 每一集都是一个邻近的未来：记忆可以重播，社交可以打分，意识可以拷进另一具身体。技术很少是唯一的反派，使用它的欲望才是。
plot_en: Each episode is a near future: memory can be replayed, social life can be scored, a mind can be copied into another body. The technology is rarely the only villain. The desire to use it is.
playbill: 单元剧，每集一个近未来科技故事：社交评分、记忆回放、意识上传，技术总在放大人性的弱点。不用按顺序看，可以先挑《圣朱尼佩洛》《白熊》《急转直下》这些口碑集。前三季整体最稳。
playbill_en: An anthology. Each episode is a near-future technology story: social scores, memory playback, uploading a mind. The technology magnifies a weakness in people. You do not have to watch in order. Start with the well-liked ones: “San Junipero,” “White Bear,” and “Nosedive.” The first three seasons are the steadiest.

plot: 汉娜·霍瓦思在布鲁克林想当作家，靠父母的钱、不稳定的工作和三位朋友撑过二十多岁。亲密关系在这里经常是尴尬的，也不打算被写成励志。
plot_en: Hannah Horvath wants to be a writer in Brooklyn, and gets through her twenties on her parents’ money, unsteady work, and three friends. Intimacy here is often embarrassing, and it is not going to be written as inspiration.
playbill: 四个二十多岁的女孩在纽约混日子，找工作、谈恋爱、互相嫌弃。它没把年轻女性拍得光鲜可爱，女主自私又尴尬，所以真实。很多观众是在这部剧里第一次认识亚当·德赖弗。
playbill_en: Four women in their twenties get by in New York: jobs, relationships, and irritation with each other. It does not make young women look glossy. The heroine is selfish and embarrassing, which is why it feels true. A lot of viewers met Adam Driver here for the first time.

plot: 得州迪隆镇用周五的高中橄榄球衡量几乎一切。教练埃里克·泰勒和妻子塔米要在胜负、孩子的前途和自己的婚姻之间做每周的决定。
plot_en: The town of Dillon, Texas, measures almost everything by Friday-night high-school football. The coach Eric Taylor and his wife Tami make the week’s decisions between winning, the children’s futures, and their own marriage.
playbill: 背景是得州小镇的高中橄榄球队，但不懂橄榄球也完全能看，重点是小镇里的人。教练和妻子的婚姻常被称为美剧里最真实的夫妻关系之一。大量手持摄影和即兴表演，让人物显得格外自然。
playbill_en: The setting is a high-school football team in a Texas town, and you can watch it without knowing the sport. The point is the people in the town. The coach’s marriage is often called one of the most believable marriages on American television. A lot of handheld camera and improvisation makes the people feel unusually natural.

plot: 凯和皮尔用短剧处理种族、流行文化和那些一开口就错位的社交场面。两个人轮流扮演权力的两边，笑话建立在身份被看错的瞬间。
plot_en: Key and Peele use sketches to handle race, pop culture, and the social moments that go wrong as soon as someone speaks. The two of them take turns playing both sides of a power relationship. The joke sits in the instant an identity is misread.
playbill: 两位喜剧演员的小品秀，每段几分钟，适合碎片时间看。很多段子讨论种族和身份，比如奥巴马和他的「愤怒翻译」路德。乔丹·皮尔后来执导了电影《逃出绝命镇》。
playbill_en: A sketch show by two comedians. Each bit is a few minutes, easy to watch in pieces. A lot of the sketches are about race and identity, such as Obama and Luther, his “anger translator.” Jordan Peele later directed Get Out.

plot: 英国政府部门的部长们还没想好政策，舆论主管马尔科姆·塔克已经闯进来改稿、骂人和收拾残局。一句话的措辞，可以毁掉一个上午。
plot_en: The ministers of a British government department have not decided the policy yet, and the communications chief Malcolm Tucker has already burst in to rewrite the draft, swear, and clean up the mess. The wording of one sentence can ruin a morning.
playbill: 英国政府部门的政治讽刺喜剧，部长们疲于应付媒体和政策灾难。彼得·卡帕尔迪饰演的舆论主管马尔科姆·塔克以花式骂人闻名。主创后来把这套风格带到美国，拍了《副总统》，还拍了电影《灵通人士》。
playbill_en: A political satire about a British government department. The ministers are exhausted by the press and by policy disasters. Peter Capaldi’s communications chief, Malcolm Tucker, is famous for the inventiveness of his swearing. The creator later took the style to the United States for Veep, and also made the film In the Loop.

plot: 更早的一档旅行美食节目。波登从厨房走向世界，用食欲、玩笑和逐渐认真起来的提问，记录一个地方怎么吃饭。
plot_en: An earlier travel-and-food series. Bourdain moves from the kitchen out into the world and records how a place eats, with appetite, jokes, and questions that get more serious as he goes.
playbill: 波登更早期的旅行美食节目，风格比《未知之境》更随性、更好玩：吃街边小摊、吐槽、喝酒、和当地人聊天。2006 年拍黎巴嫩时，摄制组遇上战争，被困贝鲁特，那一集很特别。
playbill_en: Bourdain’s earlier travel-and-food series, looser and more playful than Parts Unknown: street stalls, complaints, drinks, and talk with local people. In 2006 the crew was filming in Lebanon when the war started and they were stuck in Beirut. That episode is a thing apart.

plot: 拉里·戴维扮演一个和自己同名的电视编剧，在洛杉矶把每一件小事——小费、葬礼、一句招呼——发展成社交灾难。大纲是定的，对白常常是即兴。
plot_en: Larry David plays a television writer with his own name, and in Los Angeles turns every small thing — a tip, a funeral, a hello — into a social disaster. The outline is set. The dialogue is often improvised.
playbill: 《宋飞正传》主创拉里·戴维本色出演自己，专门把生活小事闹成灾难，比如该不该给小费、能不能多拿一份试吃。没有完整剧本，只有剧情大纲，对白多靠演员现场即兴，所以尴尬感特别真。单集基本独立，从哪集开始都行。
playbill_en: Larry David, the creator of Seinfeld, plays a version of himself and specializes in turning small questions into disasters: whether to tip, whether you can take another sample. There is no full script, only an outline, and a lot of the dialogue is improvised, so the embarrassment feels real. Episodes mostly stand alone. You can start anywhere.

plot: 洛蕾莱在十六岁生下罗里，两人在星谷镇像朋友一样一起长大。快嘴、咖啡和常春藤的申请，不断把她们拉回哈特福德那个更有钱也更严的娘家。
plot_en: Lorelai had Rory at sixteen, and the two of them grew up in Stars Hollow more like friends. Fast talk, coffee, and an application to the Ivy League keep pulling them back to the richer, stricter family in Hartford.
playbill: 单亲妈妈洛蕾莱和女儿罗里在康涅狄格的小镇生活，母女像闺蜜一样。台词语速极快，流行文化梗很密，小镇居民个个可爱，看起来非常治愈。
playbill_en: Lorelai, a single mother, and her daughter Rory live in a small town in Connecticut, more like friends than like mother and daughter. The dialogue is extremely fast, the pop-culture references are dense, and the townspeople are each a pleasure. It is very easy to feel better while watching it.

plot: 地产商乔治·布卢斯被捕后，儿子迈克尔试图拉住这个不断内斗的家族。旁白补上他们不肯承认的那半句，笑话常常要到后面几集才收回来。
plot_en: After the developer George Bluth is arrested, his son Michael tries to hold together a family that keeps turning on itself. The narrator supplies the half of the sentence they will not admit, and the jokes are often paid off several episodes later.
playbill: 富豪老爸被捕后，只有二儿子迈克尔想撑住这个家，其他人都在添乱。这是最需要专心看的喜剧之一，伏笔和梗会隔好几集甚至好几季才回收。前三季是经典；Netflix 复活的第四、五季口碑差一些。
playbill_en: After the rich father is arrested, only the second son, Michael, tries to keep the family standing. Everyone else makes it worse. It is one of the comedies you have to watch closely: setups come back episodes, or seasons, later. The first three seasons are the classic run. The fourth and fifth, revived by Netflix, were received less well.

plot: 一架客机坠毁在热带岛屿，幸存者很快发现这里不是普通的荒岛。每一集用倒叙打开一个人的过去，岛上的谜则越开越多。
plot_en: A passenger plane crashes on a tropical island, and the survivors soon find it is not an ordinary deserted island. Each episode opens someone’s past in flashback. The mysteries on the island keep multiplying.
playbill: 飞机坠毁在神秘海岛，幸存者遇到越来越多怪事。每集穿插一个人的过去，人物塑造很扎实，也带起了悬疑美剧层层埋坑的风潮。前几季极其上头，结局争议很大。
playbill_en: A plane crashes on a mysterious island, and the survivors meet stranger and stranger things. Each episode cuts in someone’s past. The people are solidly built, and the show started the fashion for mystery series that keep burying clues. The early seasons are extremely addictive. The ending was heavily argued over.

plot: 利兹·莱蒙负责一档周六晚间喜剧，上司杰克·多纳吉把管理和约会都当成并购。演员、编剧和电视网每周都在把节目从崩溃里拽回来。
plot_en: Liz Lemon runs a Saturday-night comedy show. Her boss, Jack Donaghy, treats management and dating as acquisitions. Every week the actors, the writers, and the network drag the show back from collapse.
playbill: 蒂娜·菲根据自己当《周六夜现场》首席编剧的经历改编，讲一档喜剧节目的幕后乱象。笑话密度极高，背景里也塞满了梗。亚历克·鲍德温演的电视台高管杰克是全剧最大的亮点。
playbill_en: Tina Fey based it on her years as head writer of Saturday Night Live, and it is about the chaos behind a comedy show. The jokes are packed tight, and the background is full of them too. Alec Baldwin’s network executive, Jack, is the best thing in it.

plot: 根据斯蒂芬·安布罗斯的记述，跟随美军第 101 空降师 E 连，从佐治亚的训练营走到诺曼底、阿登森林和德军的鹰巢。一连人在减员里重新认识彼此。
plot_en: Following Stephen Ambrose’s account, it stays with Easy Company of the 101st Airborne, from training camp in Georgia to Normandy, the Ardennes, and Hitler’s Eagle’s Nest. The company gets to know itself again as the numbers drop.
playbill: 汉克斯和斯皮尔伯格监制，跟着二战美军 101 空降师 E 连从训练一直走到战争结束。每集开头有真实老兵的采访，战争场面真实、残酷。第六集《巴斯托涅》和第九集《我们为何而战》尤其让人难忘。
playbill_en: Produced by Hanks and Spielberg, it follows Easy Company of the 101st Airborne from training through the end of the Second World War. Each episode opens with interviews with the real veterans. The fighting is plain and brutal. “Bastogne” and “Why We Fight” are the episodes people remember.

plot: 菲利普和伊丽莎白是潜入华盛顿郊区的克格勃特工，对外是旅行社夫妻，对内要执行莫斯科的任务。隔壁邻居正好在联邦调查局工作。
plot_en: Philip and Elizabeth are KGB agents planted in the Washington suburbs. In public they are a married couple who run a travel agency. In private they carry out Moscow’s assignments. The neighbor next door happens to work for the FBI.
playbill: 冷战时期，一对苏联间谍伪装成美国郊区夫妻，搬来的邻居偏偏是联邦调查局探员。任务戏很紧张，真正好看的是这段假婚姻怎样变成真感情，以及孩子知道真相后会怎样。结局被认为是近年最好的剧集收尾之一。
playbill_en: During the Cold War, a pair of Soviet spies pose as a married couple in an American suburb. The neighbor who moves in next door is an FBI agent. The missions are tense. What is really good is how the fake marriage becomes a real feeling, and what happens when the children learn the truth. The ending is taken as one of the best closes of a series in recent years.

plot: 路易斯安那的两名警探哈特与科尔，在 1995 年和 2012 年两个时间里讲述同一桩命案。一个女孩的尸体把他们带进沼泽、教堂和一段不愿封存的旧案。
plot_en: The Louisiana detectives Hart and Cohle tell the same murder from 1995 and from 2012. A girl’s body takes them into the swamp, a church, and an old case they do not want closed.
playbill: 只看第一季。两位警探在两条时间线里回忆一起带有邪教色彩的谋杀案，马修·麦康纳那些悲观哲学台词非常出名。第四集结尾约六分钟的长镜头被反复讨论。南方的沼泽、教堂和工厂，拍出了很强的哥特氛围。
playbill_en: Watch the first season. Two detectives recall a murder with the color of a cult, on two timelines. Matthew McConaughey’s pessimistic philosophical lines are famous. The long take of about six minutes at the end of episode four has been discussed over and over. The Southern swamp, the churches, and the factories give it a strong gothic atmosphere.

plot: 全世界百分之二的人忽然消失，没有解释。三年后，小镇上的人用邪教、职务和沉默继续生活，警察加维只想让这一天不要再裂开。
plot_en: Two percent of the world’s people vanish at once, with no explanation. Three years later, the people in a small town go on living by means of cults, jobs, and silence. The police officer Garvey only wants the day not to split open again.
playbill: 全球 2% 的人突然消失，剧集不解释原因，只关心留下来的人怎样面对失去。第一季偏压抑；第二季换到新小镇后渐入佳境；第三季结局非常动人。适合能接受慢节奏和开放问题的观众。
playbill_en: Two percent of the people on earth disappear at once. The show does not explain why. It only cares how the people who remain face the loss. The first season is on the oppressive side. The second, after a move to a new town, finds its feet. The third season’s ending is very moving. It suits someone who can take a slow pace and questions left open.

plot: 波登到各个地方吃饭，更多的时间用来坐下来听人讲政治、战争和一天的工作。食物是入场的理由，不是回避当地的办法。
plot_en: Bourdain goes places to eat, and spends more of the time sitting down to hear about politics, war, and a day’s work. The food is the reason for being let in, not a way of avoiding the place.
playbill: 安东尼·波登去世界各地吃饭，但他更关心食物背后的人、政治和历史。这不是美食打卡节目，常常会拍到战争、贫困和移民。越南那集他在河内和奥巴马一起吃烤肉米线，非常有名。
playbill_en: Anthony Bourdain travels the world to eat, but he is more interested in the people, the politics, and the history behind the food. It is not a checklist of restaurants. It often films war, poverty, and migration. The Vietnam episode, in which he eats bun cha in Hanoi with Obama, is the famous one.

plot: 菲尔德以商业顾问的身份走进真实的小店，提出过分到似乎可行的方案：假折扣、假情人和一整套让顾客困惑的手续。老板常常照做。
plot_en: Fielder walks into real small businesses as a consultant and proposes schemes that are excessive and seem as if they might work: fake discounts, a fake romance, a whole procedure designed to confuse the customer. The owners often go along.
playbill: 内森·菲尔德假扮商业顾问，给真实的小店老板出各种荒唐主意，比如开一家「笨蛋星巴克」。老板们居然认真照做，笑点来自尴尬和人们的礼貌。节目越往后越像一场关于现实与表演的实验，最后一集《寻找弗朗西丝》很特别。
playbill_en: Nathan Fielder poses as a business consultant and gives real small-business owners absurd ideas, such as a “Dumb Starbucks.” The owners actually try them. The jokes come from the embarrassment and from people’s politeness. As it goes on it becomes more like an experiment about reality and performance. The last episode, “Finding Frances,” is a thing apart.

plot: 1980 年代，一个销售天才、一个工程师和两个后来居上的女人，从克隆个人电脑做到早期网络。公司会散，人还会因为同一个想法再坐到一张桌子前。
plot_en: In the 1980s a salesman, an engineer, and two women who come up from behind go from cloning a personal computer to the early internet. The companies come apart. The people sit down at the same table again because of the same idea.
playbill: 讲 1980 到 1990 年代美国个人电脑和互联网产业的兴起。第一季像职场剧，后来逐渐变成四个人之间关于梦想、合作和失败的故事。后两季口碑特别高，常被称为最被低估的美剧之一。
playbill_en: The rise of the personal computer and the internet in the United States from the 1980s into the 1990s. The first season is like a workplace show. Later it becomes a story about four people, their ambitions, working together, and failing. The last two seasons are especially well regarded. It is often called one of the most underrated American series.

plot: 吉米·麦吉尔是个滑头律师，哥哥查克看不起他，女友金姆比他更清楚界线在哪。为了成为索尔·古德曼，他把自己一点点改名、改行、改掉。
plot_en: Jimmy McGill is a slippery lawyer. His brother Chuck looks down on him, and his girlfriend Kim knows where the line is better than he does. To become Saul Goodman he renames himself, changes his trade, and changes himself, a piece at a time.
playbill: 《绝命毒师》的前传，讲吉米怎样变成索尔·古德曼。节奏比原作慢，人物更细腻，瑞亚·西霍恩演的金是全剧最好的角色之一。没看过《绝命毒师》也能看，看过会更痛。
playbill_en: A prequel to Breaking Bad, about how Jimmy becomes Saul Goodman. It is slower than the original, and the people are drawn more finely. Rhea Seehorn’s Kim is one of the best roles in the show. You can watch it without Breaking Bad. If you have seen Breaking Bad, it hurts more.

plot: 一战结束后，汤米·谢尔比带着伯明翰的家族帮派从赛马和街头生意往上走，一路碰到爱尔兰共和军、政客和法西斯。剃刀帮要变成一门正当的权力。
plot_en: After the First World War, Tommy Shelby takes his family gang in Birmingham up from horse races and street business, and along the way meets the IRA, politicians, and fascists. The razor gang is trying to become a legitimate power.
playbill: 一战后的伯明翰，谢尔比家族从街头帮派一路打进政坛。慢镜头、摇滚配乐和大衣加报童帽的造型都非常有型。基里安·墨菲演的汤米冷静、带着战争创伤，前三季最好看。
playbill_en: Birmingham after the First World War. The Shelby family fights its way from a street gang into politics. The slow motion, the rock score, and the overcoats and flat caps are all very styled. Cillian Murphy’s Tommy is calm and carrying the war. The first three seasons are the best.

plot: 艾比和伊拉娜在纽约打工、迷路、帮忙，也不断把对方拖进更糟的主意。友情不是背景，是每一集要完成的正事。
plot_en: Abbi and Ilana work, get lost, and help each other in New York, and keep pulling each other into worse ideas. The friendship is not the background. It is the thing each episode has to get done.
playbill: 两个纽约女孩没钱也没事业，每天在城里乱逛、闯祸、互相夸奖。它是少见的以女性友谊为中心的喜剧，不靠恋爱推进。由网络短剧发展而来，风格松散，很适合下饭。
playbill_en: Two women in New York have no money and no career. They wander the city, get into trouble, and compliment each other. It is one of the few comedies built on a friendship between women, and it does not move forward on a romance. It grew out of web shorts. The style is loose, and it is easy to watch while you eat.

plot: 过气马明星波杰克住在好莱坞，靠酒、自怜和一部旧情景喜剧的重播过日子。动物和人混居的城市很好笑，直到他造成的伤害不再能用笑话盖住。
plot_en: BoJack, a washed-up horse star, lives in Hollywood on alcohol, self-pity, and the reruns of an old sitcom. The city where animals and people live together is funny, until the damage he causes can no longer be covered by a joke.
playbill: 看起来是一部荒诞的动物动画，实际在讨论抑郁、成瘾、童年创伤和名人的自我毁灭。前半季常常在搞笑，后半季会突然变得很重。第三季几乎无对白的海底一集，以及第五季的葬礼独白一集，都很经典。
playbill_en: It looks like an absurd cartoon about animals. It is about depression, addiction, childhood damage, and a celebrity destroying himself. The first half of a season is often the jokes. The second half can turn heavy without warning. The almost wordless underwater episode in season three, and the eulogy episode in season five, are the ones people come back to.

plot: 约克郡警官凯瑟琳·考伍德管着一片并不幸福的谷地。害死女儿的汤米·李·罗伊斯出狱在即，而她正在抚养的外孙，是那段暴力留下的孩子。
plot_en: Catherine Cawood, a police officer in Yorkshire, is responsible for a valley that is not happy. Tommy Lee Royce, who caused her daughter’s death, is about to get out of prison. The grandson she is raising is the child that violence left behind.
playbill: 约克郡女警凯瑟琳查一宗绑架案时，发现嫌疑人正是当年侵犯她女儿、导致女儿自杀的那个男人。犯罪线很紧，人物关系也很痛。莎拉·兰开夏演的中年女警强硬、疲惫又有幽默感。三季共 18 集。
playbill_en: While investigating a kidnapping, the Yorkshire officer Catherine finds that the suspect is the man who assaulted her daughter and led to her daughter’s suicide. The crime plot is tight, and the relationships hurt. Sarah Lancashire’s middle-aged officer is hard, tired, and funny. Three seasons, eighteen episodes.

plot: 罗斯一家把财产输光，只好搬进他们曾经当作玩笑买下的小镇。汽车旅馆的两个房间里，原来的做派一点一点碰上来自小镇的善意。
plot_en: The Rose family loses its fortune and has to move to the small town they once bought as a joke. In two rooms at the motel, the old manner collides, a little at a time, with the town’s goodwill.
playbill: 富豪一家破产，只能搬进他们当玩笑买下的小镇。第一季看着像普通的富人落难喜剧，后面越来越温暖，每个人都有成长。最后一季包揽了艾美喜剧类全部七个主要奖项。
playbill_en: A rich family goes broke and has to move to a town they bought as a joke. The first season looks like an ordinary comedy about the rich brought low. Later it gets warmer, and each person changes. The last season swept all seven major comedy Emmys.

plot: 爱尔兰女人莎朗和美国男人罗布在伦敦有了一段短暂的关系，然后是一次计划外的怀孕。他们决定留下孩子，并试着把陌生人的礼貌变成婚姻。
plot_en: Sharon, from Ireland, and Rob, from the United States, have a short relationship in London, and then an unplanned pregnancy. They decide to keep the child and try to turn the politeness of strangers into a marriage.
playbill: 美国男人和爱尔兰女人在伦敦一夜情后意外怀孕，决定在一起。这是一部很成人化的爱情喜剧，对白粗俗、坦诚又好笑。每集约 25 分钟，写婚姻和育儿很真实。
playbill_en: An American man and an Irish woman have a one-night stand in London, she gets pregnant, and they decide to stay together. It is a very adult romantic comedy: the dialogue is crude, honest, and funny. Episodes run about 25 minutes. The marriage and the child-rearing feel real.

plot: 法国外安总局的卧底「马洛特鲁」从大马士革回到巴黎，却没法把用了多年的身份脱下来。办公室用表格管理人，人用谎言管理自己。
plot_en: The undercover officer “Malotru,” of the French external service, comes back to Paris from Damascus and cannot take off an identity he has used for years. The office manages people with forms. People manage themselves with lies.
playbill: 法国对外情报局的卧底剧，没有 007 式的动作场面，重点是潜伏、审讯、伪装身份和心理压力。拍得很写实，常被认为是最接近真实情报工作的间谍剧之一。喜欢《锅匠，裁缝，士兵，间谍》的观众会对胃口。
playbill_en: An undercover series about France’s external intelligence service. There are no James Bond action scenes. The emphasis is on living undercover, interrogation, a false identity, and the psychological pressure. It is filmed very plainly, and is often taken as one of the spy shows closest to real intelligence work. If you like Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy, it will suit you.

plot: 从伊丽莎白二世登基写到世纪之交。王室在这里是一户不能辞职的人家，首相、配偶和子女都要跟职位谈判。三位演员接力扮演女王。
plot_en: It follows Elizabeth II from her accession to the turn of the century. The royal family here is a household that cannot resign. Prime ministers, spouses, and children all have to negotiate with the office. Three actors take turns as the queen.
playbill: 从伊丽莎白二世登基讲到 21 世纪初，每两季换一批演员，跟着人物一起变老。每集多围绕一个历史事件，比如艾伯凡矿难、戴安娜接受 BBC 采访，适合想了解英国现代史的人。前两季的克莱尔·福伊和马特·史密斯最受好评。
playbill_en: From Elizabeth II’s accession into the early twenty-first century. Every two seasons the cast changes, and the characters age with it. Episodes are often built around one historical event, such as the Aberfan disaster or Diana’s interview with the BBC. It suits someone who wants modern British history. Claire Foy and Matt Smith, in the first two seasons, are the most praised.

plot: 厄恩辍学回到亚特兰大，替表兄、说唱歌手纸男孩管理刚起步的事业。城市、种族和名气在这里都不按常理出牌，有的集干脆走进另一个类型。
plot_en: Earn drops out and comes back to Atlanta to manage the early career of his cousin, the rapper Paper Boi. The city, race, and fame do not behave as expected here, and some episodes simply walk into another genre.
playbill: 表面讲穷小子给当说唱歌手的表弟做经纪人，实际每一集风格都可能不同：有时是荒诞喜剧，有时像恐怖片。它写美国黑人生活很独特，不说教，却处处刺人。第二季的《泰迪·珀金斯》一集尤其出名。
