playbill_en: On the surface, a broke young man manages his cousin, a rapper. In practice each episode can be a different kind of show: sometimes an absurd comedy, sometimes something like a horror film. It writes Black life in America in its own way, without lectures, and it keeps pricking. The second-season episode “Teddy Perkins” is the one people single out.

plot: 大学生纳西尔深夜借了父亲的出租车，第二天在陌生公寓醒来，身旁是一具尸体。从警局到看守所，案件开始按它自己的程序重写这个人。
plot_en: The college student Nasir borrows his father’s taxi late at night and wakes the next day in a strange apartment, with a body beside him. From the police station to the jail, the case starts rewriting him according to its own procedure.
playbill: 巴基斯坦裔大学生一夜醒来，发现身边的女孩被刺死，自己成了头号嫌疑人。剧集一步步展示警察、律师、监狱和司法程序怎样改变一个人。改编自英剧《司法正义》，八集迷你剧。
playbill_en: A Pakistani-American college student wakes up and finds the girl beside him stabbed to death. He becomes the prime suspect. The series shows, step by step, how the police, the lawyers, the prison, and the procedure change a person. Adapted from the British series Criminal Justice. Eight episodes.

plot: 埃莉诺死后醒来，发现自己进了一套按积分分配的来世，而档案显然搞错了人。邻居、道德哲学课和一位礼貌的建筑师，一起维持这个漂亮的社区。
plot_en: Eleanor wakes up dead and finds she has entered an afterlife assigned by points, and the file has clearly got the wrong person. The neighbors, a class in moral philosophy, and a polite architect keep this handsome neighborhood going.
playbill: 女主死后被误送进「善地」，只好偷偷学做好人，以免被发现。它把伦理学和哲学问题讲得轻松好懂。第一季结尾有个大反转，最好别被剧透。
playbill_en: The heroine dies and is sent by mistake to the Good Place, so she secretly learns how to be good before anyone notices. It explains ethics and philosophy lightly enough to follow. The end of the first season has a large reversal. Better not to have it spoiled.

plot: 1980 年代的印第安纳小镇，一个男孩失踪，朋友们拿着手电筒和一套桌面游戏的术语去找他。实验、另一侧的世界，和一位编号为十一的女孩连在一起。
plot_en: In an Indiana town in the 1980s, a boy disappears. His friends go looking for him with flashlights and the vocabulary of a tabletop game. An experiment, a world on the other side, and a girl numbered Eleven are connected.
playbill: 80 年代的美国小镇，一个男孩失踪，他的朋友们和一个有超能力的女孩一起去找他。满是《E.T.》、斯蒂芬·金和《龙与地下城》式的复古氛围。第一季最完整，后几季规模更大，适合全家一起追。
playbill_en: A boy disappears in an American town in the 1980s. His friends and a girl with powers go looking for him. It is full of the retro atmosphere of E.T., Stephen King, and Dungeons & Dragons. The first season is the most complete. The later seasons are bigger. It is easy to watch as a family.

plot: 洛杉矶女演员山姆独自拉扯三个女儿，接戏、照顾母亲，也在一个不太把她当主角的行业里保持自己的日子。情节很散，一天就是一天。
plot_en: Sam, an actress in Los Angeles, raises three daughters on her own, takes jobs, looks after her mother, and keeps her own days going in an industry that does not treat her as the lead. The plot is loose. A day is a day.
playbill: 单亲妈妈山姆是个演员，在洛杉矶养三个女儿，还要照顾住在对面的母亲。剧情很生活化，常常只是一些争吵、做饭、开车的片段，却非常真实。适合喜欢女性视角和家庭题材的观众。
playbill_en: Sam, a single mother and an actress, is raising three daughters in Los Angeles and looking after her mother across the street. The episodes are ordinary life: arguments, cooking, driving, and they feel true. It suits people who want a woman’s point of view and stories about family.

plot: 一个在伦敦经营咖啡馆的女人，用对镜头说话来躲开家人、顾客和自己的悲伤。第二季里，她遇到一位同样不该越界的神父。
plot_en: A woman running a café in London talks to the camera to get away from her family, her customers, and her own grief. In the second season she meets a priest who is not supposed to cross the line either.
playbill: 女主不停对着镜头吐槽，你先被逗笑，后来才发现她在用玩笑躲开悲伤。两季共 12 集，一个下午就能看完。第二季加入安德鲁·斯科特饰演的神父，拿下 2019 年艾美喜剧类最佳剧集、女主角、编剧和导演。
playbill_en: The heroine keeps complaining to the camera. You laugh first, and later realize she is using the jokes to stay away from grief. Two seasons, twelve episodes, an afternoon. The second season adds Andrew Scott’s priest. It won the 2019 Emmys for comedy series, lead actress, writing, and directing.

plot: 伊萨在洛杉矶的非营利机构上班，和最好的朋友莫莉一起应付恋爱、工作和一句说出来就会后悔的话。南洛杉矶不是背景板，是她们来回开的那条路。
plot_en: Issa works at a nonprofit in Los Angeles and, with her best friend Molly, deals with dating, work, and the sentence that will be regretted the moment it is said. South Los Angeles is not a backdrop. It is the road they drive back and forth.
playbill: 伊萨·雷讲洛杉矶黑人女性的恋爱、工作和友谊。最好看的不是爱情线，而是伊萨和莫莉之间互相依赖又常闹矛盾的闺蜜关系。配乐很出色，五季完结。
playbill_en: Issa Rae on the dating, the work, and the friendships of Black women in Los Angeles. What is best in it is not the romance. It is the friendship between Issa and Molly, who depend on each other and fight often. The music is excellent. Five seasons, and it ends.

plot: 失踪多年的草原姑娘回到家，视力恢复了，却拒绝解释她去过哪里。她召集五个人学习一组动作，说那可能是离开这个世界的方法。
plot_en: Prairie comes home after years missing. Her sight has returned, and she refuses to explain where she has been. She gathers five people and teaches them a set of movements, which she says may be a way to leave this world.
playbill: 一个失踪七年的盲女回到家乡，不但恢复了视力，还声称自己去过另一个世界。它混合了科幻、宗教和神秘主义，风格很独特。只拍两季就被取消，结局停在一个大悬念上。
playbill_en: A blind woman missing for seven years comes home. She has her sight back, and she claims she has been to another world. It mixes science fiction, religion, and mysticism, and the style is its own. It was cancelled after two seasons, with the ending stopped on a large unanswered question.

plot: 在生育率崩溃后的基列国，能生育的女性被编为使女，分配给权贵家庭。琼以奥芙弗雷德的名字生活，记住自己原来叫什么成了一种反抗。
plot_en: In Gilead, after fertility collapses, women who can bear children are made Handmaids and assigned to the households of the powerful. June lives under the name Offred. Remembering what she used to be called becomes a form of resistance.
playbill: 改编自阿特伍德的小说：美国被极权宗教政权取代，有生育能力的女性被分配到高官家里生孩子。第一季压抑而精准，让 Hulu 成为第一个拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集的流媒体平台。后几季越拍越长，评价有所下滑。
playbill_en: Adapted from Atwood’s novel. The United States is replaced by a religious authoritarian regime, and women who can have children are assigned to the houses of senior officials to bear them. The first season is oppressive and exact. It made Hulu the first streaming service to win the Emmy for best drama. The later seasons got longer, and the reception slipped.

plot: 财务顾问马蒂·伯德为墨西哥卡特尔洗钱失败，带着家人躲到欧扎克湖区，用当地生意把脏钱洗干净。妻子温迪很快不再满足于只做掩护。
plot_en: The financial adviser Marty Byrde fails at laundering money for a Mexican cartel and takes his family to the Lake of the Ozarks, using local businesses to clean the money. His wife Wendy soon wants to be more than the cover.
playbill: 理财顾问一家被迫逃到密苏里的湖区，替墨西哥贩毒集团洗钱。比《绝命毒师》更冷，更像一部家庭求生剧。朱莉娅·加纳演的当地女孩露丝是全剧亮点，凭此拿了三座艾美奖。
playbill_en: A financial adviser’s family is forced to flee to a lake district in Missouri and launder money for a Mexican cartel. It is colder than Breaking Bad, and more like a family trying to survive. Julia Garner’s local girl Ruth is the highlight, and she won three Emmys for it.

plot: 查普尔用短剧和现场观众谈话，把种族、名人和电视本身的假正经拆开。许多段子后来被反复引用，也变成他和节目关系破裂的一部分。
plot_en: Chappelle uses sketches and talk with the studio audience to take apart race, celebrity, and the false propriety of television. Many of the bits were quoted for years afterward, and became part of the break between him and the show.
playbill: 戴夫·查普尔的小品秀，大胆处理种族、名人和流行文化，「瑞克·詹姆斯」等段子至今仍被引用。节目巅峰期，查普尔突然离开，引发大量讨论，最后只完整播出了两季。
playbill_en: Dave Chappelle’s sketch show, which handles race, celebrity, and pop culture directly. Bits such as “Rick James” are still quoted. At the height of the show, Chappelle walked away, and that departure was argued over at length. Only two seasons were completed.

plot: 职业杀手巴里·伯克曼到洛杉矶执行任务，误入一堂表演课，决定自己也许可以成为演员。杀人的手艺和想被看见的欲望开始抢同一个日程。
plot_en: The hit man Barry Berkman comes to Los Angeles for a job, wanders into an acting class, and decides he might become an actor. The work of killing and the wish to be seen start competing for the same calendar.
playbill: 一名杀手来洛杉矶接活，误打误撞进了表演班，想转行当演员。开头是黑色喜剧，越往后越黑暗，接近犯罪悲剧。比尔·哈德尔既主演也执导，第二季的《罗尼/莉莉》一集非常出名。
playbill_en: A hit man comes to Los Angeles for a job, stumbles into an acting class, and tries to switch careers. It starts as a black comedy and gets darker, closer to a crime tragedy. Bill Hader stars and directs. The second-season episode “ronny/lily” is the famous one.

plot: 媒体巨头洛根·罗伊中风之后，四个子女开始计算谁能接过公司。他们有钱、有伤害，也有一句永远说不出口的话：父亲并不打算交给任何人。
plot_en: After the media magnate Logan Roy has a stroke, his four children start calculating who can take the company. They have money and they have injuries, and they have a sentence they can never say: their father does not intend to give it to anyone.
playbill: 媒体帝国的父亲和四个子女争继承权，很像现代版《李尔王》。台词刻薄又好笑，几乎每个人都很糟，但都很好看。四季结构完整、结局干脆，三次拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
playbill_en: A media empire’s father and his four children fight over the succession. It is a lot like a modern King Lear. The dialogue is cruel and funny. Almost everyone is awful, and good to watch. Four seasons, a complete shape, a clean ending. It won the Emmy for best drama three times.

plot: 它不是漫画的逐格重拍。故事从 1921 年塔尔萨的种族屠杀开场，再落到一个蒙面警察仍在执勤的美国，雷吉娜·金饰演的安吉拉要查清父辈留下的身份。
plot_en: It is not a panel-by-panel remake of the comic. The story opens with the 1921 massacre in Tulsa and then settles in an America where masked police are still on duty. Angela, played by Regina King, has to find out the identity her father’s generation left her.
playbill: 不是电影版的翻拍，而是原著漫画的续集，故事放在 2019 年。它把超级英雄故事和美国的种族暴力史连在一起，开场就是 1921 年的塔尔萨种族屠杀。不看原著也能看，看过会更有收获。共获 11 项艾美奖。
playbill_en: It is not a remake of the film. It is a sequel to the original comic, set in 2019. It joins a superhero story to the history of racial violence in the United States. It opens with the 1921 Tulsa massacre. You can watch it without the comic. If you have read it, there is more. It won 11 Emmys.

plot: 马克和杰里米合住在伦敦南边。镜头钻进他们的眼睛，旁白说出他们真正在想的话：一个是焦虑的贷款经理，一个是不肯找工作的音乐人。
plot_en: Mark and Jeremy share a flat in south London. The camera goes in through their eyes, and the narration says what they are actually thinking: one is an anxious loan manager, the other a musician who will not get a job.
playbill: 英国情景喜剧，大量第一视角镜头配上两位男主的内心独白，你能同时听到他们说出口的话和心里的真实想法。一个焦虑古板，一个懒散不靠谱，互相嫌弃又离不开。编剧之一杰西·阿姆斯特朗后来创作了《继承之战》。
playbill_en: A British sitcom. A lot of it is shot from a first-person view, with the two men’s interior monologue, so you hear what they say and what they actually think. One is anxious and prim. The other is lazy and unreliable. They cannot stand each other and cannot leave. One of the writers, Jesse Armstrong, later created Succession.

plot: 在《侠盗一号》之前，卡西恩·安多还不是叛军英雄。他被卷进偷窃、监狱和一场需要账本、演讲和牺牲才能运转的革命。
plot_en: Before Rogue One, Cassian Andor is not yet a rebel hero. He is pulled into a theft, a prison, and a revolution that runs on ledgers, speeches, and sacrifice.
playbill: 《星球大战》衍生剧，但几乎不靠绝地武士和原力，讲的是普通人怎样被逼上反抗之路。政治、监狱和谍报线都写得很成熟，不看其他星战作品也能看懂。第一季的监狱篇是全剧高峰，第二季结尾直接接上电影《侠盗一号》。
playbill_en: A Star Wars series that barely relies on Jedi or the Force. It is about ordinary people being pushed into resistance. The politics, the prison, and the spycraft are written for adults, and you can follow it without the other films. The prison stretch of the first season is the high point. The end of the second season runs straight into Rogue One.

plot: 变装皇后比赛服装、表演和口播，输的人在对嘴演唱里争取留下。后台的友谊、竞争和一句评语，构成每一季的剧情。
plot_en: Drag queens compete in costume, performance, and talking to camera. The loser lip-syncs for the chance to stay. Friendships, competition, and a single remark backstage make the plot of each season.
playbill: 变装皇后竞赛真人秀，比服装、表演、喜剧和对嘴唱。它把变装文化带进主流，也带火了很多选手和流行语。毒舌点评和后台八卦都很好看。
playbill_en: A reality competition for drag queens: costume, performance, comedy, and lip-sync. It brought drag into the mainstream, and made a lot of contestants and catchphrases. The sharp judging and the backstage gossip are both good to watch.

plot: 两位成年女演员扮演 2000 年的自己，回到初中：即时通讯、不合身的衣服，以及一份认真到可笑的友谊。周围的同学由真正的少年扮演。
plot_en: Two adult actresses play themselves in the year 2000 and go back to middle school: instant messaging, clothes that do not fit, and a friendship taken seriously to the point of being ridiculous. The classmates around them are played by actual adolescents.
playbill: 两位 30 多岁的女演员扮演 13 岁的自己，同学则由真正的 13 岁孩子出演。拍的是 2000 年前后初中生活里的尴尬、暗恋、友谊和种种第一次，很搞笑，也很诚实。
playbill_en: Two actresses in their thirties play themselves at 13. The classmates are played by actual 13-year-olds. It is middle school around 2000: the embarrassment, the crushes, the friendship, and the various first times. Very funny, and honest.

plot: 莱斯利·诺普在印第安纳州波尼镇的公园部门工作，相信会议、表格和一份更厚的早餐能改善公共生活。同事们大多不信，但还是跟着她做。
plot_en: Leslie Knope works for the parks department in Pawnee, Indiana, and believes that meetings, forms, and a larger breakfast can improve public life. Her colleagues mostly do not believe it, and follow her anyway.
playbill: 小镇公园部门的莱斯莉真心想为社区做点事，身边的同事一个比一个奇葩。第一季比较像《办公室》的翻版，从第二季开始变得温暖又好笑。尼克·奥弗曼演的罗恩·斯旺森是经典角色。
playbill_en: Leslie, in a small-town parks department, genuinely wants to do something for the community. The colleagues around her are each stranger than the last. The first season is fairly close to a copy of The Office. From the second season it becomes warm and funny. Nick Offerman’s Ron Swanson is a classic role.

plot: 过气棒球投手肯尼·鲍尔斯回到家乡，在中学当体育老师，同时确信自己仍是明星。粗话、毒品和一场并不存在的复出，构成他的生活安排。
plot_en: Kenny Powers, a baseball pitcher past his prime, comes home and teaches phys ed at the middle school, while remaining sure he is still a star. Obscenity, drugs, and a comeback that does not exist are how he arranges his life.
playbill: 过气棒球明星肯尼·鲍尔斯回乡当体育老师，自大、粗鲁、满嘴脏话。笑点很低俗，但也是对美式男子气概的讽刺。丹尼·麦克布莱德演得非常放得开。
playbill_en: Kenny Powers, a washed-up baseball star, comes home to teach phys ed. He is vain, rude, and foul-mouthed. The jokes are low, and they are also a satire of an American idea of manhood. Danny McBride plays him without holding back.

plot: 1986 年，切尔诺贝利核电站爆炸。科学家列加索夫、官员谢尔比纳和核物理学家霍缪克要在谎言已经发出去之后，把还没做完的灾难拦住。
plot_en: In 1986 the Chernobyl nuclear plant explodes. The scientist Legasov, the official Shcherbina, and the nuclear physicist Khomyuk have to stop a disaster that is not finished, after the lie has already gone out.
playbill: 五集迷你剧还原 1986 年核事故，从爆炸当夜一直讲到事后审判。最可怕的不是辐射画面，而是官僚系统怎样掩盖真相。氛围压抑，细节考究，豆瓣评分在 9 分以上。
playbill_en: A five-episode miniseries of the 1986 nuclear accident, from the night of the explosion through the hearings afterward. What is most frightening is not the images of radiation. It is how the bureaucracy covered up what had happened. The atmosphere is oppressive, the detail is careful, and the Douban score sits above 9.

plot: 孤儿贝丝·哈蒙在收养家庭里靠镇静剂看见棋盘，然后在 1960 年代一路下到国际赛场。天才是真的，依赖、孤独和那套要她好看的世界也是真的。
plot_en: Beth Harmon, an orphan, sees the chessboard in the tranquilizers at her adoptive home, and then plays her way to international tournaments in the 1960s. The talent is real. So are the dependence, the loneliness, and a world that wants her to look good.
playbill: 孤儿院长大的女孩贝丝靠天赋成为国际象棋高手，同时与药物和酒精成瘾对抗。不懂下棋也能看懂，比赛拍得像体育片一样紧张。60 年代的服装美术很漂亮，七集就看完。
playbill_en: Beth, who grows up in an orphanage, becomes a chess champion on talent, and at the same time fights an addiction to drugs and alcohol. You can follow it without knowing chess. The matches are filmed with the tension of a sports movie. The 1960s clothes and design are beautiful. Seven episodes and it is done.

plot: 每一则短剧都从一件普通的事开始：一场会议、一顶帽子、一次聚餐。然后有人拒绝停下，社交场面按照他的逻辑滑出正常世界。
plot_en: Each sketch starts from an ordinary thing: a meeting, a hat, a dinner. Then someone refuses to stop, and the social situation slides out of the normal world according to his logic.
playbill: 蒂姆·罗宾逊的小品秀。每段都从普通的社交场合开始，然后有人死不认错，越闹越离谱。笑点非常怪，对上频道的人会笑疯。每集不到 20 分钟，节奏极快。
playbill_en: Tim Robinson’s sketch show. Each bit starts in an ordinary social situation, and then someone will not admit they are wrong, and it gets further out of hand. The jokes are very strange. If you are on its wavelength, you will lose it. Episodes run under 20 minutes, and the pace is fast.

plot: 斯莱戈的中学里，康奈尔和玛丽安秘密在一起；到了都柏林的三一学院，阶级和说话的方式对调了。他们一再分开，又在对方最熟悉的沉默里相遇。
plot_en: In a school in Sligo, Connell and Marianne are together in secret. At Trinity College in Dublin, class and the way of speaking trade places. They keep separating, and meeting again in the silence the other person knows best.
playbill: 改编自萨莉·鲁尼的小说，讲两个爱尔兰年轻人从高中到大学的分分合合。剧情不靠大事件，靠误会、沉默和阶层差异让人揪心。保罗·麦斯卡因此走红，亲密戏拍得自然而克制。
playbill_en: Adapted from Sally Rooney’s novel. Two young people in Ireland come together and apart from secondary school through university. It does not run on big events. It runs on misunderstandings, silence, and class, and that is what makes it hurt. Paul Mescal became known for it. The sex is filmed plainly and with restraint.

plot: 一场流感之后，巡演的交响乐团在五大湖边的废墟之间走路，用莎士比亚换食宿。一本漫画把疫情之夜的几个陌生人，在二十年后又接起来。
plot_en: After a flu, a traveling symphony walks among the ruins around the Great Lakes and trades Shakespeare for food and a bed. A comic book joins several strangers from the night of the outbreak, twenty years later.
playbill: 一场致命流感摧毁文明 20 年后，一支巡回剧团在废墟间演出莎士比亚。剧情在疫情前、疫情中和多年之后来回切换。它不像典型的末日剧那么暴力，更关心艺术、记忆和人与人之间的联系。
playbill_en: Twenty years after a lethal flu destroys civilization, a traveling troupe performs Shakespeare among the ruins. The story moves between before the outbreak, during it, and years later. It is less violent than a typical end-of-the-world show. It is more interested in art, memory, and the ties between people.

plot: 一群负债的人同意参加一套童年游戏，赢家拿走巨额奖金，输家死在场上。成奇勋以为自己还能用善良理解规则，规则却只认人数。
plot_en: A group of people in debt agree to play a set of children’s games. The winner takes a huge prize. The losers die on the field. Seong Gi-hun thinks he can still understand the rules through kindness. The rules only count the numbers.
playbill: 456 个负债累累的人参加童年游戏，输了就死，赢家拿走巨额奖金。设定简单，视觉鲜艳，第一季成了 Netflix 史上观看量最高的剧集。真正打动人的，是每个参赛者被生活逼到绝境的处境。
playbill_en: 456 people deep in debt play children’s games. Lose and you die. The winner takes a huge sum. The premise is simple and the images are bright. The first season became the most-watched series in Netflix’s history. What actually moves you is the position each player has been pushed into by ordinary life.

plot: 俄克拉何马保留地上的四个原住民少年打算离开这里，去加州。一个朋友的死让出走变成未完成的心愿，社区里的长辈则不断把他们拉回具体的生活。
plot_en: Four Indigenous teenagers on a reservation in Oklahoma plan to leave for California. A friend’s death turns the leaving into an unfinished wish, and the elders in the community keep pulling them back into the specifics of a life.
playbill: 四个原住民少年在俄克拉何马的保留地偷东西攒钱，想去加州完成死去朋友的心愿。编剧、导演和主要演员几乎都是原住民，幽默里带着一点魔幻。三季完结，越往后越动人。
playbill_en: Four Indigenous teenagers on a reservation in Oklahoma steal to save money. They want to go to California and finish a dead friend’s wish. The writers, directors, and principal cast are almost all Indigenous. The humor has a little of the supernatural in it. Three seasons, and it ends. It gets more moving as it goes.

plot: 卢蒙公司的员工接受手术，把工作记忆和生活记忆切开。电梯下行之后，另一个自己开始上班，并且不想永远留在楼里。
plot_en: Employees of Lumon accept a procedure that splits work memory from life memory. After the elevator goes down, another self starts the shift, and does not want to stay in the building forever.
playbill: 公司员工通过手术把工作记忆和生活记忆分开，上班的自己不知道下班的自己是谁。设定新奇，复古冷色的办公室美术辨识度极高。悬念层层推进，第一季结尾非常抓人。本·斯蒂勒执导了第一季的大部分剧集。
playbill_en: A company’s employees undergo a procedure that separates the memory of work from the memory of life. The self at work does not know who the self at home is. The premise is new, and the retro, cold-colored office design is immediately recognizable. The mysteries stack up. The end of the first season grabs you. Ben Stiller directed most of the first season.

plot: 军情五处把犯错的特工发配到斯劳部门，由邋遢的冷战老人杰克逊·兰姆看管。这群被叫做慢马的人，仍会撞上总部不想亲手处理的案子。
plot_en: MI5 posts the agents who have made mistakes to Slough House, under Jackson Lamb, a slovenly old man from the Cold War. The people called the slow horses still run into the cases the head office does not want to handle itself.
playbill: 军情五处把犯了错的特工发配到「斯劳屋」，这群失败者却总能卷进真正的大案。加里·奥德曼演的上司杰克逊·兰姆邋遢、毒舌又极其能干，光看他就值回票价。每季六集，节奏快，适合一口气看完。
playbill_en: MI5 exiles the agents who have failed to Slough House, and this group of losers keeps getting pulled into real cases. Gary Oldman’s boss, Jackson Lamb, is slovenly, vicious, and extremely capable. He alone is worth it. Six episodes a season, fast, easy to watch in one sitting.

plot: 美国橄榄球教练泰德·拉索被雇去执教一支英国足球队，东家原本指望他搞砸。他用饼干和不肯嘲讽人的办法，先改变了更衣室。
plot_en: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, is hired to manage an English soccer team. The owner originally expected him to wreck it. He starts by changing the locker room, with biscuits and a refusal to mock people.
playbill: 完全不懂足球的美国橄榄球教练，去执教一支英超球队。他乐观到近乎傻，却慢慢感染了身边的人。第一季是最暖的职场喜剧之一，后面几季单集变长，节奏也变散。
playbill_en: An American football coach who knows nothing about soccer is hired to manage a Premier League team. He is optimistic to the point of seeming foolish, and slowly infects the people around him. The first season is one of the warmest workplace comedies. Later seasons make the episodes longer, and the pace looser.
